subquestions.question: Will at least one elected Minnesota state legislator affiliated with the Democratic-Farmer-Labor (DFL) Party publicly call for Tim Walz to resign as Governor by January 25, 2026?
subquestions.background_information:
Minnesota Governor Tim Walz is currently facing intense scrutiny and demands for his resignation from Republican leaders following investigations into widespread welfare, education, and social services fraud within the state. The fraud scandal involves over $1 billion in misappropriated taxpayer funds. On December 16, 2025, U.S. Education Secretary Linda McMahon publicly called for Walz to resign, citing a 'dereliction of duty' (https://www.foxnews.com/politics). Other Republican figures, such as U.S. Representatives James Comer and Tom Emmer, as well as state-level Republicans like gubernatorial candidate Kristin Robbins, have aggressively demanded accountability and suggested resignation (https://www.theepochtimes.com/us). Up to this point, the pressure has been almost exclusively partisan. Walz's own party, the Minnesota Democratic-Farmer-Labor (DFL) Party, has historically supported him. However, if the scandal deepens to the point where an elected member of the DFL breaks ranks and explicitly calls for his resignation, it would serve as a powerful signal that Walz is losing crucial internal political support, significantly increasing the probability of his eventual resignation.

Sources:
Fox News - https://www.foxnews.com/politics
The Epoch Times - https://www.theepochtimes.com/us
Star Tribune - https://www.startribune.com
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves 'Yes' if, between 2025-12-29 and 2026-01-25 (inclusive), at least one currently serving elected state legislator in Minnesota (either a State Representative or a State Senator) who is officially affiliated with the Democratic-Farmer-Labor (DFL) Party publicly states that Tim Walz should resign, step down, or otherwise vacate the office of Governor of Minnesota.

The public statement must be made unequivocally. Acceptable forms of a public statement include: a published press release, a recorded interview or quote provided to a credible news organization, a post on the legislator's official or verified personal social media account, or an official statement made during legislative proceedings.

Phrases such as 'he must resign,' 'it is time for him to step down,' or 'he should vacate the office' will count toward resolution. Statements that merely call for an investigation, express disappointment, or state that Walz should 'consider his political future' without explicitly suggesting resignation will not count.

The legislator must be a sitting member of the Minnesota House of Representatives or Minnesota Senate at the exact time the statement is made, which can be verified via the official Minnesota Legislature roster (https://www.leg.mn.gov/leg/legislators).

The primary resolution sources will be credible local and national reporting, such as the Star Tribune (https://www.startribune.com) or Minnesota Public Radio (https://www.mprnews.org), as well as direct evidence from the official Minnesota House or Senate websites (https://www.house.mn.gov, https://www.senate.mn). If no such event occurs within the specified window, the question resolves 'No'.
subquestions.rationale: Resignation of a high-ranking official like a Governor is often highly contingent on the support of their own party. As long as the calls for Walz's resignation remain strictly from the opposing political party, they can largely be dismissed or weathered as partisan attacks. The defection of a DFL legislator calling for his resignation would indicate a serious, undeniable erosion of his political base. Such a public break in ranks is a strong leading indicator that his position is becoming untenable, making this an ideal crux for evaluating whether he will actually resign by the end of January.

question: Ukraine recognizes Russian sovereignty over its territory by December 31, 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if a deal in which Ukraine agrees to formally recognize Russian sovereignty over any UN-recognized Ukrainian territory is reached between the Russian Federation and Ukraine by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

The deal must be a publicly announced mutual agreement. 

If such an agreement is officially reached before the resolution date, this market will resolve to "Yes", regardless of if/when the agreement goes into effect.

An agreement by Ukraine formally recognizing Russian sovereignty over any UN-recognized Ukrainian territory for any amount of time will count.

An agreement by Ukraine formally recognizing Russian sovereignty over any UN-recognized Ukrainian territory as a precondition of a more comprehensive peace process or deal will qualify, even if the agreement is not finalized or part of a formalized peace deal. The September 8, 1995, “Agreed Basic Principles” between Bosnia and Yugoslavia, which recognized the borders and sovereignty of Bosnia and Herzegovina, and was later formalized through the Dayton Peace Agreement, is an example of a qualifying agreement.

An official unilateral pledge by Ukraine formally recognizing Russian sovereignty over any UN-recognized Ukrainian territory will qualify for a “Yes” resolution even if not part of an agreement with Russia.

The April 19, 2013, Brussels Agreement between Serbia and Kosovo, in which Serbia recognized Kosovo’s de facto administration but did not formally grant de jure recognition, would not be considered a qualifying agreement under this market, as this market requires formal recognition of sovereignty rather than acknowledgment of administrative control.

The primary resolution source for this market will be an official announcement by Ukraine and/or the Russian Federation, however, an overwhelming consensus of credible reporting confirming an agreement has been reached will also qualify.

subquestions.question: Will the Ukrainian government officially announce a nationwide referendum regarding the status of its territories or peace terms with Russia between September 1, 2025, and October 1, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and Ukrainian lawmakers have vehemently rejected formal territorial concessions, emphasizing that such actions violate the Ukrainian Constitution. Lawmakers have explicitly stated that altering Ukraine's territorial makeup requires a nationwide referendum (https://www.yahoo.com/news/shocked-us-peace-proposal-ukrainians-000000000.html). Furthermore, officials warned that any peace agreement recognizing Russian control would risk unrest, making a referendum politically necessary to secure a mandate for such a drastic constitutional change (https://kyivindependent.com/dangerous-and-cruel-trumps-reported-crimea-proposal-sparks-horror-among-ukraines-lawmakers/). Because a referendum is a legal and political prerequisite to changing Ukraine's borders or formally conceding territory, whether the Ukrainian government initiates one is a critical indicator of their willingness to agree to a peace deal involving territorial concessions to Russia.

Sources:
Yahoo News: https://www.yahoo.com/news/shocked-us-peace-proposal-ukrainians-000000000.html

subquestions.resolution_criteria:

The announcement must be an official statement, published decree, or passed parliamentary resolution representing the government's formal stance. Unofficial comments, proposals by individual politicians, or unconfirmed rumors do not qualify.

If no such official announcement is made between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01T23:59:59Z, the question resolves to 'No'. If the announcement is delayed beyond this resolution window, the question resolves to 'No'.

Sources to be used for resolution include the official website of the President of Ukraine (https://www.president.gov.ua/en) and the official portal of the Verkhovna Rada (https://www.rada.gov.ua/en), supplemented by credible international reporting such as Reuters (https://www.reuters.com) and the Kyiv Independent (https://kyivindependent.com).
subquestions.rationale: For Ukraine to formally recognize Russian sovereignty over any of its UN-recognized territory, it would likely need to bypass or amend constitutional prohibitions against territorial concessions. Ukrainian officials have explicitly stated that altering the country's territorial makeup requires a nationwide referendum. Therefore, an official announcement of a referendum in September 2025 would be a highly informative early indicator that Ukraine is preparing the legal and political groundwork to formally recognize Russian sovereignty by the end of 2025. Conversely, if no referendum is announced, the likelihood of the ultimate question resolving 'Yes' decreases significantly, given the time needed to organize such a vote and change the legal framework.

question: Israel strikes Iran by October 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Israel initiates a drone, missile, or air strike on Iranian soil or any official Iranian embassy or consulate by October 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

For the purposes of this market, a qualifying "strike" is defined as the use of aerial bombs, drones or missiles (including cruise or ballistic missiles) launched by Israeli military forces that impact Iranian ground territory or any official Iranian embassy or consulate (e.g., if a weapons depot on Iranian soil is hit by an Israeli missile, this market will resolve to "Yes").

Missiles or drones which are intercepted and surface-to-air missile strikes will not be sufficient for a "Yes" resolution regardless of whether they land on Iranian territory or cause damage.

Actions such as artillery fire, small arms fire, FPV or ATGM strikes directly, ground incursions, naval shelling, cyberattacks, or other operations conducted by Israeli ground operatives will not qualify.

The resolution source will be a consensus of credible reporting.

subquestions.question: Will the IDF or US DoD officially confirm that a projectile launched from Iranian territory targeted Israel between October 1, 2025, and October 25, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
The conflict between Israel and Iran's 'Axis of Resistance' has seen severe escalations over the past year. Iran-backed groups, particularly the Houthis in Yemen, have consistently targeted Israel with drones and ballistic missiles, prompting Israeli retaliatory airstrikes, such as the September 16, 2025 strike on the port of Hodeida (https://www.timesofisrael.com/israel-strikes-houthi-held-port-of-hodeida-in-response-to-drone-and-rocket-fire/). Direct confrontations between Israel and Iran have also set historic precedents; Iran launched major direct missile and drone attacks against Israel in April and October 2024, and Israel has faced significant drone and missile bombardments throughout 2025, requiring extensive use of US-supplied THAAD and Patriot interceptors (https://www.csis.org/analysis/enduring-role-fires-modern-battlefield). A direct attack originating from Iranian territory represents a significant escalation that historically increases the likelihood of an Israeli military retaliation. Determining whether Iran launches a direct attack in early to mid-October serves as a critical early indicator of whether Israel will conduct a direct strike on Iranian soil by the end of October.

Sources:
The Times of Israel: Israel strikes Houthi-held port of Hodeida in response to drone and rocket fire - https://www.timesofisrael.com/israel-strikes-houthi-held-port-of-hodeida-in-response-to-drone-and-rocket-fire/
CSIS: The Enduring Role of Fires on the Modern Battlefield - https://www.csis.org/analysis/enduring-role-fires-modern-battlefield
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-25 (inclusive), the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) or the United States Department of Defense (US DoD) releases an official statement confirming that at least one projectile (such as a drone, cruise missile, or ballistic missile) was launched from within the borders of Iran and targeted the territory of the State of Israel (or was intercepted while en route to Israeli territory).

To count toward a Yes resolution, the official statement must explicitly attribute the launch to Iranian soil and state that it was directed at Israel. Statements confirming attacks by Iranian proxies (such as the Houthis in Yemen, Hezbollah in Lebanon, or militias in Iraq and Syria) do not qualify unless the specific projectile is confirmed to have been launched directly from Iranian territory. The announcement must be published via an official IDF or US DoD channel—such as the official IDF website (https://www.idf.il/en/), official DoD press releases (https://www.defense.gov/News/Press-Releases/), official social media accounts belonging to these organizations, or during a televised press briefing by official spokespersons—within the resolution window.

If no such confirmation is made by the end date, or if a projectile is launched but its origin from Iranian soil is not officially confirmed by the IDF or US DoD between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-25, the question resolves No.
subquestions.rationale: The ultimate question asks whether Israel will strike Iranian soil by October 31, 2025. Israel's willingness to directly strike Iran is heavily dependent on Iran's direct actions against Israel. A direct attack from Iranian territory against Israel acts as a clear casus belli, dramatically increasing the probability that Israel responds with a direct strike on Iranian soil. Tracking whether Iran launches a direct attack acts as a highly informative crux for forecasters predicting an Israeli retaliatory strike.

subquestions.question: Will the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) publicly acknowledge conducting a new airstrike within Yemen between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01?
subquestions.background_information: Tensions between Israel, Iran, and the Iran-backed Houthi movement in Yemen have reached unprecedented levels in mid-2025. In late August 2025, after a Houthi ballistic missile launch toward central Israel, the IDF executed extensive retaliatory airstrikes on Houthi targets in Sanaa, Yemen, striking a power plant, fuel storage, and a presidential palace compound. Because airstrikes in Yemen require similar long-range capabilities (e.g., ~2,000 km range, aerial refueling) as strikes on Iran, further IDF strikes in Yemen serve as a reliable indicator of Israel's military readiness and willingness to escalate. Monitoring whether Israel continues this long-range bombing campaign in September 2025 provides a strong crux for forecasting whether Israel will conduct direct strikes on Iranian soil before 2026. Sources: AP News: https://apnews.com/article/israel-airstrikes-yemen-houthis-sanaa Australian Broadcasting Corporation: https://www.abc.net.au/news/2025-08-24/israeli-retaliatory-strikes-hit-yemeni-presidential-palace Yahoo News: https://www.yahoo.com/news/idf-strikes-houthi-targets-hodeidah
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to 'Yes' if the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) officially acknowledges conducting a new airstrike or missile strike within the internationally recognized borders of Yemen (including its territorial waters), where both the strike itself and the official acknowledgment occur between 2025-09-01 00:00:00 UTC and 2025-10-01 23:59:59 UTC (inclusive). Acknowledgments of strikes that occurred prior to September 1, 2025, will not trigger a 'Yes' resolution. question: Apple Vision Pro 2 released by December 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Apple releases a new Vision Pro product by December 31, 2025 ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

A qualifying product must be named "Apple Vision" and be recognized as a successor to the original Apple Vision Pro product, similar to the relationship between iPhone 14 and iPhone 15. A new Apple Vision product released without a number, under a designation other than Apple Vision Pro 2 will qualify if it retains the original functions of the Apple Vision Pro and expands on them in such a way that it is clear that this product is a successor.

In order to be considered released, the product must be available for purchase by the general public within the specified timeframe. An announcement or unveiling alone is not sufficient.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official statements from Apple. However, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

subquestions.question: Will Apple officially announce a successor to the Apple Vision Pro between September 1, 2025, and September 30, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
Apple is scheduled to hold a major product launch event on September 9, 2025, referred to in invitations as the 'Awe Dropping' event. According to recent industry reporting, Apple is expected to unveil a full slate of new products at this event, including the new iPhone 17 lineup and potentially a new generation of Apple Vision Pro headsets powered by either an M4 or M5 processor (https://www.macworld.com/article/2025/09/get-ready-for-a-packed-month-of-apple-releases.html). Bloomberg's Mark Gurman and other tech outlets have reported that Apple has been working on a specification bump for the Vision Pro, including prototyping new head straps and bolstering the neural engine (https://9to5mac.com/2025/08/31/expecting-future-generations-apple-vision-pro-roadmap/). While the ultimate question requires the product to be available for purchase by the end of 2025, Apple's standard product cycle heavily relies on formal announcements prior to hardware releases. The September event serves as a primary window for such announcements.

Sources:
Macworld - https://www.macworld.com/article/2025/09/get-ready-for-a-packed-month-of-apple-releases.html
9to5Mac - https://9to5mac.com/2025/08/31/expecting-future-generations-apple-vision-pro-roadmap/

subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if Apple officially announces a hardware successor to the original Apple Vision Pro between 2025-09-01 and 2025-09-30 (inclusive). A 'successor' is defined as a new spatial computing headset in the 'Apple Vision' line (such as 'Apple Vision Pro 2', an explicitly named new generation, or a version featuring an M4/M5 chip upgrade) that retains and expands on the original's functionality. The announcement must be made publicly by Apple, either via a presentation during an official Apple Event or through a press release on the Apple Newsroom (https://www.apple.com/newsroom/). The product does not need to be released or available for purchase within this window; a formal announcement or unveiling is sufficient for a Yes resolution. If no such announcement occurs between 2025-09-01 and 2025-09-30 (inclusive), the question resolves No.
subquestions.rationale: Hardware products are typically announced by Apple weeks or months before their retail release. Since the ultimate question asks if a Vision Pro successor will be released by December 31, 2025, an official announcement during Apple's major September 9 hardware event (or anytime in September) is a critical leading indicator. If Apple announces the device in September, a 2025 release becomes highly probable. If September passes without an announcement, the probability of a release before the end of the year decreases significantly.

question: Will TIME's Person of the Year for 2025 be a woman?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the individual named as TIME's Person of the Year for 2025 is a woman. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

In the event that multiple individuals are named TIME's 2025 Person of the Year, this market will resolve to "Yes" if at least one of them is a woman.

If for any reason the 2025 TIME's Person of the Year is not announced by January 31, 2026 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No".

This market will resolve based on Time's cover. However, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

subquestions.question: Will the daily closing price for any individual woman reach 15¢ ($0.15) or higher in Polymarket's TIME Person of the Year 2025 market between October 31 and November 30, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
TIME's Person of the Year is typically announced in early to mid-December (e.g., Taylor Swift was named in early December 2023). Speculation and prediction markets heat up in November. According to Just Jared (published Sept 30, 2025), there are rumors Donald Trump might be selected, while a Showbiz411 article (Oct 10, 2025) suggests TIME may have shut the door on Trump, criticizing his candidacy and floating the idea of 'brave immigrants' instead. As the decision approaches, prediction markets like Polymarket act as highly accurate aggregators of rumors, news, and insider sentiment. Tracking whether any individual woman maintains a solid probability (15% or greater) on prediction markets during November is a strong crux for the ultimate outcome. If a female candidate hits this threshold, it indicates that the betting public considers a woman to be a highly viable contender just weeks before the award is announced.

Sources:
Polymarket: https://polymarket.com/
Just Jared: https://www.justjared.com/2025/09/30/donald-trump-reportedly-set-to-be-named-time-person-of-the-year/
Showbiz411: https://www.showbiz411.com/2025/10/10/time-magazine-seems-to-shut-the-door-on-trump-getting-person-of-the-year
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if a qualifying event occurs between 2025-10-31 and 2025-11-30 (inclusive). Specifically, it resolves Yes if the daily closing price for any contract representing an individual woman reaches 15¢ ($0.15) or higher on any day within this window, on the primary market for 'TIME Person of the Year 2025' hosted on Polymarket (https://polymarket.com).

The following conditions apply:
1. 'Individual woman' means a single, specific female person (e.g., Kamala Harris, Taylor Swift). Contracts representing groups of people (e.g., 'Women of the Year', 'Brave Immigrants') do not qualify, even if they include women.
2. The daily closing price will be determined using the official historical price chart provided on the Polymarket platform for the respective contract.
3. The 'primary market' is defined as the TIME Person of the Year 2025 market with the highest total trading volume on Polymarket during the resolution window.
4. If Polymarket does not host a TIME Person of the Year 2025 market between 2025-10-31 and 2025-11-30, or if no individual woman's contract achieves a daily closing price of at least 15¢ during the window, this question resolves No.
subquestions.rationale: Prediction markets effectively synthesize all available public information, including rumors, editorial trends, and current events. A woman achieving an implied probability of 15% or more in the month leading up to the announcement is a strong early indicator that female contenders are highly viable. This provides a measurable, objective milestone before the final TIME magazine reveal, acting as a valuable crux for forecasters.

subquestions.question: Will Eric Adams publicly agree to Jim Walden's ranked-choice poll pledge by October 1, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
In the lead-up to the November 2025 New York City mayoral election, Democratic socialist Zohran Mamdani is leading in the polls with approximately 44% support. Non-Democratic or independent candidates are currently splitting the alternative vote, with Andrew Cuomo at 25%, Republican Curtis Sliwa at 12%, and incumbent Mayor Eric Adams at 7%. To consolidate the opposition against Mamdani, attorney and candidate Jim Walden introduced a pledge for the four non-Democratic candidates to participate in an October ranked-choice poll. The agreement stipulates that only the winner of this poll would continue to the general election, while the others would presumably step aside to prevent a split vote. Andrew Cuomo has already joined the pledge, but Adams and Sliwa have yet to follow suit. If Adams signs the pledge, it strongly signals his willingness to step aside and potentially back Cuomo, who currently holds a commanding lead over Adams in the polls.

Sources:
Editorial: Jim Walden To The Rescue? - The Wave: https://rockawave.com/articles/editorial-jim-walden-to-the-rescue/
NewsMax - Mamdani Leaves NY Business Leaders Divided: https://www.newsmax.com
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves 'Yes' if Eric Adams, or his official campaign representatives, publicly announce that he has signed, joined, or formally agreed to participate in Jim Walden's proposed ranked-choice poll pledge between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01 at 11:59 PM ET.

The agreement must be confirmed via an official channel (such as an official press release or Adams' official campaign social media, e.g., https://x.com/ericadamsfornyc) or reported by a consensus of credible news organizations (e.g., The New York Post at https://nypost.com, The New York Times at https://www.nytimes.com, or Politico at https://www.politico.com).

If no such announcement or credible reporting is published between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01 (inclusive), the question resolves 'No'. If Adams drops out of the mayoral race during this window without ever explicitly agreeing to the pledge, this question also resolves 'No'.
subquestions.rationale: Jim Walden's pledge serves as an active structural mechanism for candidates to drop out and consolidate support behind the strongest non-Mamdani candidate. Because Cuomo has already signed the pledge and is heavily outpolling Adams, Adams agreeing to participate is a strong leading indicator that he is prepared to concede the race and endorse Cuomo to avoid splitting the moderate vote.

question: Will tariffs generate >$250b in 2025?
description:
The U.S. government collected $82.2b in customs duties in FY 2025 (See: https://www.fiscal.treasury.gov/files/reports-statements/financial-report/2024/notes-to-the-financial-statements19.pdf).

This market will resolve to "Yes"  if the value of costumes duties collected in FY 2025 according to the Financial Report of the United States Government published by the Treasury Department for FY 2025 (See: https://www.fiscal.treasury.gov/reports-statements/financial-report/) is greater than $250b. Otherwise this market will resolve to "No". 

If the Treasury Department does not publish relevant data  for FY 2025 by February 28, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No". 

The resolution source will be the Treasury Department.

subquestions.question: Will the U.S. Treasury report $45 billion or more in customs duties for the month of August 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
Through July 2025, U.S. customs duty collections reportedly reached $150 billion for the fiscal year, with a record $28 billion collected in July alone. President Trump implemented higher 'reciprocal' tariffs on U.S. trading partners effective August 1, 2025. For the U.S. government to reach the $250 billion threshold by the end of Fiscal Year 2025 (which ends September 30, 2025), it must collect roughly $100 billion over the final two months—averaging $50 billion per month. The U.S. Department of the Treasury publishes monthly tariff revenue data in the Monthly Treasury Statement (MTS) (https://www.fiscal.treasury.gov/reports-statements/mts/). The August 2025 MTS, typically released in mid-September, will provide the first clear indicator of whether the August 1 tariffs are generating revenue at the pace needed to exceed $250 billion for the fiscal year.

Sources:
U.S. Treasury Monthly Treasury Statement: https://www.fiscal.treasury.gov/reports-statements/mts/
U.S. Treasury Financial Report: https://www.fiscal.treasury.gov/reports-statements/financial-report/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if the U.S. Treasury Department's Monthly Treasury Statement (MTS) for August 2025 reports that 'Customs duties' receipts for the month of August are $45 billion ($45,000 million) or greater.

The official resolution source will be the August 2025 Monthly Treasury Statement published by the U.S. Treasury (https://www.fiscal.treasury.gov/reports-statements/mts/). The specific value will be taken from 'Table 3. Summary of Receipts and Outlays of the U.S. Government' (or the corresponding 'Receipts by Source' table) under the 'Customs duties' row for the 'This Month' column.

This question resolves Yes if the qualifying event (the publication of the August 2025 MTS showing customs duties of at least $45,000 million) occurs between the start date of 2025-09-01 and the end date of 2025-09-30 (inclusive). If the published figure is less than $45,000 million, or if the U.S. Treasury Department does not publish the August 2025 MTS by 2025-09-30 at 11:59 PM ET, the question will resolve No.
subquestions.rationale: To hit >$250 billion in FY 2025 after reaching $150 billion by July, the U.S. needs to average $50 billion in customs duties for August and September. Since new 'reciprocal' tariffs took effect on August 1, the August MTS will be the ultimate crux for whether these new rates are high enough to bridge the remaining $100 billion gap. A strong August showing (>$45 billion) strongly predicts the FY 2025 total will surpass the $250 billion threshold.

question: Macron out in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Emmanuel Macron ceases to be President of France for any length of time between January 2 and December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET (inclusive). Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

subquestions.question: Will the French government led by Prime Minister François Bayrou fall via a successful vote of no confidence between September 1, 2025, and October 1, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
France is currently navigating a severe political crisis. Prime Minister François Bayrou, who heads a minority government, is facing a critical confidence vote scheduled for September 8, 2025. The vote centers around Bayrou's highly controversial proposal for €44 billion in spending cuts and tax increases, which includes scrapping two public holidays and freezing spending increases (https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/). 

Opposition parties across the spectrum, from the far-right National Rally to the far-left France Unbowed, have expressed intent to vote against the plans and topple the government. Far-left leader Jean-Luc Mélenchon has explicitly demanded that President Emmanuel Macron resign if Bayrou loses the confidence vote (https://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/). 

If the government falls, Macron would be forced to appoint his seventh Prime Minister since 2017, dissolve the parliament again, or resign. Although Macron has publicly vowed to serve out his mandate until its conclusion in 2027 (https://www.yahoo.com/news/), the successful passage of a no-confidence motion is a critical trigger event that would massively escalate pressure on his presidency.

Sources:
- The Straits Times: https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/
- Hurriyet Daily News: https://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/
- Yahoo News: https://www.yahoo.com/news/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if a motion of no confidence (motion de censure) against the government of Prime Minister François Bayrou is formally passed by the French National Assembly between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01 (inclusive). 

The adoption of the motion must result in the fall of the government and must be confirmed by the official records of the French National Assembly (https://www2.assemblee-nationale.fr/) or a consensus of credible reporting from major international news outlets, such as France 24 (https://www.france24.com/en/) or Le Monde (https://www.lemonde.fr/en/).

If François Bayrou steps down for reasons other than a formally adopted motion of no confidence (e.g., a voluntary resignation without a vote), or if a motion of no confidence fails to secure the necessary absolute majority, or if the vote is postponed and does not pass within the resolution window, the question resolves No. The vote must take place and successfully pass within the strict time window between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01.
subquestions.rationale: The scheduled September 8 confidence vote is the most immediate and tangible threat to the current French political administration. A successful motion of no confidence would collapse Bayrou's government, stall the budget, and drastically amplify calls for President Macron's resignation. It acts as an excellent leading indicator; forecasters assessing the likelihood of Macron stepping down in 2025 will anchor their probabilities heavily on whether his Prime Minister survives this imminent legislative hurdle.

question: Will Hezbollah disarm in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Hezbollah officially announces it will disarm in Lebanon by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Only announcements supported by the Secretary-General of Hezbollah (currently Naim Qassem), a direct successor, or, if the position of Secretary-General of Hezbollah is vacant, the widely acknowledged leadership of Hezbollah will qualify. 

For the purposes of this market, "disarm" refers to a public commitment to relinquish or dismantle its military, whether partially or completely, in Lebanon.

Announcements of partial disarmament (e.g., surrendering a class of weapons or agreeing to disarm in stages or a certain region) will qualify as long as it is part of an acknowledged disarmament process.

Only official announcements will qualify. Informal statements, plans contingent on future conditions, statements of intent without a formal policy directive, or any other statements that do not constitute a formal policy announcement will not be considered.

Primary resolution sources will include official statements from Hezbollah leadership; however, a wide consensus of credible reporting confirming a policy of disarmament has been instituted will also qualify.

subquestions.question: Will Israel officially announce or begin a withdrawal of its ground forces from at least one occupied position in southern Lebanon between October 1 and October 31, 2025?
subquestions.background_information: The Lebanese government has ordered the military to draft a plan to disarm Hezbollah by the end of 2025 (https://www.khaama.com/lebanese-government-orders-military-to-disarm-hezbollah/). However, Hezbollah's leadership, including Naim Qassem, has explicitly refused to disarm, citing the ongoing Israeli occupation of five strategic positions in southern Lebanon as a primary justification for retaining their weapons (https://tribune.com.pk/story/hezbollah-refuses-to-be-disarmed). Israel has tied any pullback of its forces to Hezbollah's disarmament, offering a 'phased reduction' of IDF presence if Lebanon seizes Hezbollah's arms (https://www.bssnews.net/news/israel-pm-offers-phased-withdrawal-if-lebanon-disarms-hezbollah). U.S. envoy Tom Barrack is mediating a roadmap that requires a cessation of Israeli occupation alongside Lebanon's security overhaul (https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/lebanon-what-will-it-take-disarm-hezbollah). Because Hezbollah's refusal to disarm is officially conditioned on the presence of Israeli troops, a withdrawal by Israel from these positions would indicate a significant breakthrough in the U.S.-brokered negotiations, greatly increasing the probability that Hezbollah will subsequently agree to a disarmament framework. Sources: Khaama Press (https://www.khaama.com/lebanese-government-orders-military-to-disarm-hezbollah/), The Express Tribune (https://tribune.com.pk/story/hezbollah-refuses-to-be-disarmed), BSS News (https://www.bssnews.net/news/israel-pm-offers-phased-withdrawal-if-lebanon-disarms-hezbollah), Middle East Eye (https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/lebanon-what-will-it-take-disarm-hezbollah).
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if either of the following occurs between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 (inclusive): 1) The Israeli Prime Minister's Office, the Ministry of Defense, or the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) releases an official statement announcing the withdrawal of Israeli ground troops from at least one of the five strategic positions they currently occupy in southern Lebanon. 2) A physical withdrawal of IDF ground forces from at least one of these positions begins and is confirmed by a wide consensus of credible reporting. The withdrawal must be a genuine relinquishment of the position; temporary tactical rotations or realignments that do not hand over or vacate the territory do not qualify. If neither an official announcement nor a verified withdrawal occurs within the specified window, the question resolves No. Primary sources for resolution will be official press releases from the IDF (https://www.idf.il/en/) or the Israeli Prime Minister's Office (https://www.gov.il/en/departments/prime_ministers_office), as well as reporting from major news agencies such as Reuters (https://www.reuters.com) or the Associated Press (https://apnews.com).
subquestions.rationale: Hezbollah claims its weapons are necessary to defend Lebanon against Israeli occupation, explicitly conditioning any discussion of disarmament on the complete withdrawal of Israeli forces from southern Lebanon. Conversely, Israel states it will only pull back if Hezbollah disarms. An Israeli withdrawal would strongly signal that a backroom agreement regarding Hezbollah's disarmament has been reached or that a major pretext for Hezbollah's armed status has been removed, serving as a highly informative early indicator for the ultimate question.

question: Israel x Iran ceasefire broken by March 31, 2026?

This market will resolve to "Yes" if either Israel initiates a drone, missile, or air strike on Iranian soil or any official Iranian embassy or consulate, or Iran initiates a drone, missile, or air strike on Israeli soil or any official Israeli embassy or consulate, by 11:59 PM ET on the listed date. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

For the purposes of this market, a qualifying "strike" is defined as the use of aerial bombs, drones or missiles (including cruise or ballistic missiles) launched by Israeli or Iranian military forces that impact the other party’s ground territory or any official embassy or consulate (e.g., if a weapons depot on Iranian soil is hit by an Israeli missile, or an Israeli air base is hit by an Iranian drone, this market will resolve to "Yes") that is officially acknowledged by the relevant government or a consensus of credible reporting.

Missiles or drones which are intercepted and surface-to-air missile strikes will not be sufficient for a "Yes" resolution regardless of whether they land on the opposing party’s territory or cause damage.

subquestions.question: Will Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu hold an in-person meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump in Washington, D.C. before February 5, 2026?
subquestions.background_information:
Following the 12-day war in June 2025 between Israel and Iran, a ceasefire was brokered by Donald Trump on June 24, 2025. Despite the ceasefire, tensions remain exceedingly high. On December 21, 2025, IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir warned that Israel would strike enemies 'wherever required', implicitly suggesting a potential new military campaign against Iran. Concurrently, reports emerged that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu intends to present plans for a new attack on Iran to President Donald Trump during an upcoming visit to Washington. Israel remains highly concerned about Iran rebuilding its ballistic missile capabilities, with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stating that damaged facilities have been fully reconstructed. Since Israel would likely seek U.S. coordination, intelligence sharing, or a 'green light' before launching a preemptive strike on Iranian soil, an upcoming diplomatic meeting between the two leaders serves as a critical indicator for the possibility of the ceasefire breaking.

Sources:
The Times of Israel: https://www.timesofisrael.com/
France 24: https://www.france24.com/en/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and U.S. President Donald Trump hold an in-person meeting in Washington, D.C., between 2026-01-06 and 2026-02-05 (inclusive of both dates). 

To count towards a Yes resolution, the meeting must involve both leaders being physically present in the same room. Virtual meetings, phone calls, or meetings taking place entirely outside of Washington, D.C. (e.g., at Mar-a-Lago in Florida or another location) will not count for a Yes resolution. 

The meeting must be officially acknowledged through press releases, statements, or schedules published by the White House (https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefing-room/) or the Israeli Prime Minister's Office (https://www.gov.il/en/departments/prime_ministers_office/govil-landing-page), or confirmed by a consensus of credible, major news organizations (e.g., Associated Press at https://apnews.com/ or Reuters at https://www.reuters.com/). 

If either Netanyahu or Trump ceases to hold their respective offices prior to a meeting taking place, a meeting between their successors will not count for a Yes resolution. If no qualifying meeting occurs by 11:59 PM ET on 2026-02-05, the question will resolve No.
subquestions.rationale: Reports indicate that Benjamin Netanyahu plans to present Israel's plans for a new attack on Iran to Donald Trump during a visit to Washington. Whether this meeting takes place is a strong early indicator of the timeline and likelihood of a potential Israeli strike, as breaking the ceasefire would heavily rely on U.S. backing or coordination.

question: Will 'Wicked: For Good' have the best domestic opening weekend in 2025?
description:
This is a market on how whether 'Wicked: For Good' (2025) will gross more domestically on its opening weekend than any other movie in 2025. The “Weekend Box Office Performance” table on https://www.the-numbers.com/movie/Wicked-For-Good-(2025)#tab=box-office will be used to resolve this market once the values for the 3-day opening weekend (November 21 - 23) are final (i.e. not studio estimates).

This market will resolve to "Yes" if 'Wicked: For Good' (2025) grosses more on its 3-day domestic opening weekend than any other movie in 2025. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Please note, this market will resolve according to the The Numbers figures provided under Weekend Box Office Performance for the 3-day weekend, regardless of whether domestic refers to only the USA, or to USA and Canada, etc.

Resolution will be based specifically on the figures provided for this movie's 3-day opening weekend (Friday, Saturday, Sunday), regardless of whether the movie has a 4 or 5-day opening weekend.

If another movie's opening weekend box office performance surpasses that of 'Wicked: For Good' (2025) after numbers for both are finalized, this market may immediately resolve to "No".

If this movie's opening weekend box office performance ties with any other's, the movie whose title comes first in alphabetical order will win.

If there is no final data available by January 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, another credible resolution source will be chosen.

subquestions.question: Will Deadline report that "Wicked: For Good" earned at least $15.0 million domestically in its preview screenings?
subquestions.background_information:
"Wicked: For Good" is scheduled to release in North American theaters on Friday, November 21, 2025, with preview screenings typically held the day before, on Thursday, November 20. The ultimate question asks whether the film will have the highest domestic opening weekend of 2025. Current box office projections for the movie are mixed: Deadline estimates a $112M-$115M debut, whereas Box Office Pro predicts a higher $130M-$155M range. To secure the biggest opening weekend of 2025, the film will likely need to surpass "Lilo & Stitch", which reportedly opened to $146 million earlier in the year. A movie's preview gross (which includes Thursday previews and any earlier fan events) is a highly reliable early indicator of its weekend performance. To reach an opening weekend near or above $146 million, a preview gross of $15.0 million or more is generally necessary. If the previews fall short of this $15.0 million mark, the film will likely track closer to the $112M-$115M forecast, making it highly unlikely to break the 2025 record.

Sources:
The Numbers Box Office Data: https://www.the-numbers.com/movie/Wicked-For-Good-(2025)#tab=box-office
Deadline Box Office Reporting: https://deadline.com/v/box-office/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-31 and 2025-11-22 (inclusive), Deadline (https://deadline.com) publishes an article reporting an estimated or actual domestic preview gross (typically Thursday previews, possibly including earlier fan screenings) for "Wicked: For Good" of $15.0 million or more. 

The resolution will be based on the official figures reported by Deadline. If Deadline reports a range (e.g., "$14.5M-$16M"), the lower bound must be $15.0 million or greater to resolve Yes. If multiple estimates are published by Deadline within the resolution window, the most recent estimate published before 2025-11-22 at 23:59 UTC will be used. If Deadline does not publish any specific preview screening figures for the film by the end of 2025-11-22, this question resolves No.
subquestions.rationale: Preview screening figures are typically released on the Friday morning of an opening weekend and serve as the strongest early indicator of total weekend box office. A preview gross of $15 million or more signals that the movie is tracking towards the higher end of its $130M-$155M projections, which would put it in direct contention to achieve the highest opening weekend of the year (surpassing the $146M mark). If it fails to hit this benchmark, forecasters can confidently update their probabilities downward on the ultimate question.

question: Starmer out in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if Keir Starmer ceases to be the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom for any period of time between February 2 and December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

An announcement of Keir Starmer's resignation/removal before this market's end date will immediately resolve this market to "Yes", regardless of when the announced resignation/removal goes into effect.

The resolution source for this market will be the government of the UK, however a consensus of credible reporting will also suffice.

subquestions.question: Will any full member of the UK Cabinet resign, be dismissed, or otherwise leave the Cabinet between September 1, 2025, and October 1, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
Keir Starmer's government has faced severe economic and political turbulence in mid-2025. Reports indicate that the UK bond market suffered a sharp sell-off—reminiscent of the 2022 Liz Truss crisis—after Starmer's initial failure to publicly back Chancellor Rachel Reeves in Parliament. Furthermore, Sky News reported that Starmer's public approval ratings plummeted, with 73% of UK adults unsatisfied with his performance in an Ipsos survey, the lowest score for a prime minister's first year. Anonymous senior Labour MPs have expressed 'unhappiness and despair,' suggesting Starmer might be forced out within months. In UK politics, the resignation or dismissal of a senior Cabinet minister is often the first tangible domino to fall before a prime minister is ousted, as seen with Boris Johnson in 2022. Tracking whether a Cabinet member leaves their post is a highly informative early indicator of whether Starmer's administration is nearing collapse.

Sources:
Sky News Politics: https://news.sky.com/politics
BBC News UK Politics: https://www.bbc.com/news/politics
UK Government Announcements: https://www.gov.uk/government/announcements
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if any full member of the UK Cabinet officially resigns, is dismissed, or is otherwise removed from the Cabinet between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01 (inclusive).

'Full member of the UK Cabinet' is defined as any minister listed as a Cabinet Minister on the official UK government website (https://www.gov.uk/government/ministers) at the start of or during the resolution window.

A departure counts if the minister leaves the Cabinet entirely; a reshuffle where a minister is merely moved to a different full Cabinet role does not count. Ministers who 'also attend Cabinet' but are not full Cabinet members are excluded. Departures explicitly and solely due to death or a sudden medical emergency are excluded.

The official announcement or confirmation of the departure must occur between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01. Delayed events or announcements outside this window will not be counted.

Resolution will be determined by official UK Government press releases (https://www.gov.uk/government/announcements). If the official government site is unavailable or ambiguous, a consensus of credible UK reporting (e.g., BBC News at https://www.bbc.com/news/politics, Sky News, and The Guardian) will serve as the fallback.
subquestions.rationale: A Cabinet resignation or dismissal is a classic leading indicator of a deeply troubled premiership in the UK. Given the reports of intra-party despair and economic instability, a minister departing in September 2025 would signal a fracturing of government unity, drastically increasing the likelihood that Starmer's position becomes untenable and he is ousted by the end of 2025.

question: Bank of Japan decreases interest rates after January 2026 meeting?
description:
The Statement on Monetary Policy for the Bank of Japan's Monetary Policy meeting for January is scheduled to be released on January 23, 2026 (https://www.boj.or.jp/en/mopo/mpmsche_minu/index.htm).

This market will resolve to the amount of basis points the upper bound of the short-term policy interest rate is changed by versus the level it was prior to the Bank of Japan's January 2026 meeting.

If the short-term policy interest rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded up to the nearest 25 and will resolve to the relevant bracket. (e.g. if there's a cut/increase of 12.5 bps it will be considered to be 25 bps)

The primary resolution source for this market will be the official website of the Bank of Japan (https://www.boj.or.jp/en/mopo/mpmsche_minu/index.htm), however a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

This market may resolve as soon as the Bank of Japan's statement for their January meeting with relevant data is issued. If no statement is released by the end date of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the "No change" bracket.

subquestions.question: Will Japan's preliminary Q3 2025 real GDP annualized growth rate be reported at or below 0.0%?
subquestions.background_information:
The Bank of Japan (BOJ) is balancing the need to control inflation with the risks of stalling economic growth. After ending its massive stimulus and raising its policy rate to 0.5% in January 2025, policymakers have emphasized that further rate decisions depend heavily on the economy demonstrating solid health and sufficient wage growth. Newly elected Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi is known for her reflationary economic stance and preference for accommodative policy, meaning any economic weakness would heavily discourage further rate hikes and could instead pressure the BOJ to ease policy and cut rates. Japan's preliminary Gross Domestic Product (GDP) data for the third quarter (Q3) of 2025, typically released by the Cabinet Office in mid-November, will be a vital indicator. If the Japanese economy contracts or stagnates—indicated by a real GDP quarter-over-quarter annualized growth rate of 0.0% or lower—it would serve as a strong signal of economic fragility. This weakness would significantly increase the likelihood that the BOJ decreases interest rates at its January 2026 meeting to stimulate the economy.

Sources:
Cabinet Office of Japan National Accounts (GDP) Statistics: https://www.esri.cao.go.jp/en/sna/menu.html
Bank of Japan Monetary Policy: https://www.boj.or.jp/en/mopo/index.htm
Reuters via Investing.com - BOJ preview Oct: rates to remain on hold: https://www.investing.com/news/economy/boj-preview-oct-rates-to-remain-on-hold-outlook-in-focus-amid-sticky-inflation-4321098
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if the Cabinet Office of Japan reports that the preliminary real Gross Domestic Product (GDP) quarter-over-quarter annualized growth rate for Q3 2025 is 0.0% or lower. The qualifying report must be officially released between the start date of 2025-11-08 and the end date of 2025-12-08 (inclusive).

The primary resolution source will be the official press release or statistical data tables from the Cabinet Office of Japan website (https://www.esri.cao.go.jp/en/sna/menu.html).

Only the initial (first preliminary) release published within the 2025-11-08 to 2025-12-08 window will be considered for resolution. Any subsequent revisions, whether published within or outside the window, will not affect the resolution. If the event is delayed and the preliminary data is not published between 2025-11-08 and 2025-12-08, the question will resolve No. The reported annualized percentage figure will be evaluated exactly as reported without any additional rounding by the resolver (e.g., -0.1% or 0.0% resolves Yes; 0.1% resolves No).
subquestions.rationale: A contraction or stagnation in real GDP serves as a major headwind against the BOJ's tightening cycle. If Japan's economy shrinks, the BOJ is highly unlikely to continue hiking rates and will face intense political and economic pressure to cut rates (decrease the policy rate) at the January 2026 meeting to support growth. Therefore, Q3 GDP data acts as a highly informative crux for the ultimate interest rate decision.

question: Will Trump's approval rating hit 40% in 2025?

subquestions.question: Will the official U.S. Consumer Price Index (CPI-U) year-over-year change for August 2025 be 2.5% or greater?
subquestions.background_information:
President Donald Trump's overall approval rating is heavily influenced by his handling of the economy and inflation, areas where he holds significant net-negative ratings (such as -13% on the economy and -26% on inflation, according to Silver Bulletin analysis). Pollsters note that inflation anxiety, partly driven by newly implemented tariffs, is a primary headwind for his administration's popularity. Earlier in the year, the 12-month inflation rate had slowed to 2.3%.

Tracking the trajectory of inflation provides a strong leading indicator for Trump's political standing. If the August 2025 CPI data (scheduled for release in mid-September) shows an acceleration back to 2.5% or above, it would represent a tangible economic setback. Such an event would likely suppress his approval ratings further, pushing the overall Silver Bulletin metric closer to the 40% threshold.

Sources:

Newsweek: https://www.newsweek.com/
WBMA: https://abc3340.com/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reports that the 12-month (year-over-year) percentage change in the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U), All Items, Not Seasonally Adjusted, for the month of August 2025 is 2.5% or greater (e.g., 2.5%, 2.6%, etc.).

For resolution, this official release must occur between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01 (inclusive). The primary resolution source will be the headline 12-month change published in the official BLS 'Consumer Price Index Summary' news release for August 2025, which can be found at https://www.bls.gov/news.release/cpi.nr0.htm and the broader CPI data portal at https://www.bls.gov/cpi/.

Subsequent revisions to the data made after the initial release date will not affect the resolution. If the BLS does not release the August 2025 CPI-U data between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01, or permanently ceases to publish this specific metric, the question will resolve as unresolvable.
subquestions.rationale: Trump's approval ratings are currently weakest on economic issues, particularly inflation and trade. An acceleration of inflation (CPI-U >= 2.5%) in the September data release would reignite consumer anxieties over prices and tariffs. Because economic sentiment is a primary driver of presidential approval, a poor inflation report serves as a strong early indicator that his overall approval rating could deteriorate to the 40% mark by the end of 2025.

question: Will Hamas agree to disarm by December 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Hamas officially announces it will disarm in the Gaza Strip by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Only credible announcements, for example by the widely acknowledged leadership of Hamas, will qualify.

For the purposes of this market, "disarm" refers to a public commitment to relinquish or dismantle its military, whether partially or completely, in the Gaza Strip.

Announcements of partial disarmament (e.g., surrendering a class of weapons or agreeing to disarm in stages or a certain region) will qualify as long as it is part of an acknowledged disarmament process.

Only official announcements will qualify. Informal statements, plans contingent on future conditions, statements of intent without a formal policy directive, or any other statements that do not constitute a formal policy announcement will not be considered.

Primary resolution sources will include official statements from Hamas leadership; however, a wide consensus of credible reporting confirming a policy of disarmament has been instituted will also qualify.

subquestions.question: Will Hamas and Fatah officially announce an agreement to form a unified government or joint committee to govern the Gaza Strip between 2025-11-30 and 2025-12-25?
subquestions.background_information:
A US-backed 20-point peace plan, currently in its first phase, mandates a ceasefire and hostage releases in Gaza. The upcoming 'Phase Two' requires the dismantling of Hamas's military infrastructure and the demilitarization of the territory under international monitoring (https://www.nzherald.co.nz/). However, Hamas has consistently rejected unilateral disarmament or handing over weapons to a foreign-led 'Board of Peace' or International Stabilisation Force (https://www.gatestoneinstitute.org/). On November 26, 2025, Hamas spokesman Hazem Qassem reiterated that the group will not disarm unless the issue is resolved through an 'internal Palestinian dialogue' and national consensus, tying the fate of its weapons to a broader political agreement with other Palestinian factions (https://www.israelnationalnews.com/). Hamas is currently engaging in consultations with Fatah and regional mediators to reach such an understanding before moving to Phase Two. A formal governance agreement between Hamas and Fatah is widely viewed as a necessary precursor to any potential announcement of disarmament, as Hamas insists any security forces must be integrated into a unified Palestinian state structure.

Sources:
NZ Herald - https://www.nzherald.co.nz/
Gatestone Institute - https://www.gatestoneinstitute.org/
Arutz Sheva Israel News - https://www.israelnationalnews.com/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-11-30 and 2025-12-25 (inclusive), official representatives of both Hamas and Fatah (or the Palestinian Authority), or an official government statement from a mediating country (such as Egypt, Qatar, or Turkey), publicly announce that Hamas and Fatah have reached a formal agreement to form a unified government, administration, or joint committee to govern the Gaza Strip.

The announcement must confirm that an agreement has been finalized. Statements indicating that talks are merely progressing, that a draft is being reviewed, or that an agreement is strictly contingent on future unspecified conditions will not qualify. The agreement must cover the governance of the Gaza Strip, though it may also include the West Bank.

If no such announcement is made by the end of 2025-12-25, the question resolves No. Delayed events or announcements made after 2025-12-25 will not count towards a Yes resolution, and the question will resolve No in such cases. 

Primary resolution sources will include official statements published on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs websites of Qatar (https://www.mofa.gov.qa/) or Egypt (https://mfa.gov.eg/), as well as credible reporting confirming the official announcements from major news agencies such as Reuters (https://www.reuters.com/) or the Associated Press (https://apnews.com/). If these specific websites become unavailable, archived versions or equivalent official statements distributed to international press will be used.
subquestions.rationale: Hamas explicitly ties the issue of its weapons and potential disarmament to an 'internal Palestinian dialogue' and the establishment of a unified Palestinian government, refusing to yield to foreign authorities. Therefore, before Hamas can officially announce any form of disarmament by the ultimate question's deadline of December 31, it must first establish this internal consensus with Fatah. Tracking whether this political agreement is reached by December 25 provides a high-value early indicator: failure to reach a governance agreement makes it highly improbable they will agree to disarm by December 31. Conversely, if an agreement is reached, it clears the primary internal hurdle Hamas has cited, significantly increasing the probability of a subsequent disarmament announcement.

subquestions.question: Will Tesla Inc. (TSLA) stock close at a price at least 10% lower than its first September 2025 trading day closing price on any day before October 2025?
subquestions.background_information:

However, his wealth has experienced extreme volatility throughout 2025, dropping by over $60 billion earlier in the year primarily due to swings in Tesla's stock price and external political pressures concerning electric vehicle subsidies (https://www.benzinga.com/markets/equities/25/08/40209873/elon-musks-wealth-takes-more-than-60-billion-hit-in-2025-as-bill-gates-also-sees-huge-losses-but-one). Meanwhile, his closest rivals—Larry Ellison and Mark Zuckerberg—have fortunes around $277 billion and $254 billion respectively, driven by robust tech and AI stock performances (https://townflex.com/top-20-richest-people-in-the-world-2025-forbes-real-time-billionaires-list/). Because Musk's number one ranking heavily depends on his massive holdings in Tesla, an acute downward trend in TSLA stock is the most likely driver for him losing his top spot on the Bloomberg Billionaires Index. 

Sources:
Forbes Real-Time Billionaires List: https://www.forbes.com/real-time-billionaires/
Benzinga - Elon Musk Wealth Hit: https://www.benzinga.com/markets/equities/25/08/40209873/elon-musks-wealth-takes-more-than-60-billion-hit-in-2025-as-bill-gates-also-sees-huge-losses-but-one

subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if the official closing price of Tesla Inc. (TSLA) stock on the NASDAQ exchange is at least 10.00% lower than its official closing price on the first trading day of September 2025 (expected to be September 2, 2025) on any trading day between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01 (inclusive). To determine resolution, the resolver will calculate the threshold: [First Sept 2025 Trading Day Closing Price] * 0.90. If the closing price on any subsequent trading day within the 2025-09-01 to 2025-10-01 window is less than or equal to this threshold, the question resolves Yes. Intraday drops that recover before the market closes do not count; only the official end-of-day closing price is considered. The primary data source will be Yahoo Finance historical data for TSLA (https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/TSLA/history/). If Yahoo Finance is unavailable, Google Finance (https://www.google.com/finance/quote/TSLA:NASDAQ) will serve as the fallback. If TSLA stock splits or issues dividends during this period, adjusted closing prices will be used to accurately reflect the 10% drop in valuation.
subquestions.rationale: Elon Musk's wealth is highly concentrated in Tesla. A substantial 10% drop in Tesla's stock price over the span of a single month would wipe out tens of billions of dollars from his net worth. Observing such downward volatility in the near term acts as an excellent early indicator (crux) that Musk's buffer over fast-rising competitors like Ellison or Zuckerberg is deteriorating, increasing the probability that he will lose the #1 rank before the end of the year.

question: Will USA win the 2025 Ryder Cup?
description:
In the 2025 Ryder Cup, scheduled for September 25-28, 2025.

If Team USA wins the 2025 Ryder Cup by finishing with more total points than Team Europe, this market will resolve to "Yes". Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

subquestions.question: Will Team USA win the Friday morning opening session (Session 1) at the 2025 Ryder Cup?
subquestions.background_information: The 2025 Ryder Cup will be played at the Bethpage Black Course in Farmingdale, New York, from September 26-28, 2025. The format consists of 28 match-play contests over three days. The competition kicks off on Friday, September 26, with the opening session in the morning, which traditionally features four foursomes (alternate shot) matches. Each match is worth one point, with a tie awarding a half-point to each side. Momentum in the Ryder Cup is highly influential, and the winner of the opening session often gains a significant psychological advantage. For the United States, utilizing the home-course advantage at Bethpage Black to jump out to an early lead against Team Europe could be pivotal. Team USA must score 14.5 points in total to reclaim the trophy. Sources: 1. Official Ryder Cup Website (https://www.rydercup.com), 2. PGA Tour (https://www.pgatour.com), 3. Yahoo Sports (https://sports.yahoo.com/golf/).
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves 'Yes' if Team USA scores strictly more points than Team Europe in the Friday morning session (Session 1) of the 2025 Ryder Cup. The qualifying events for this resolution must occur between the start date of 2025-09-01 and the end date of 2025-09-26. Specifically, Session 1 must be completed by the end of the day on 2025-09-26, and Team USA must earn strictly more points than Team Europe in that session alone (e.g., scoring at least 2.5 points out of 4 available). If Team USA scores equal to or fewer points than Team Europe, or if the session is cancelled or not completed on or before 2025-09-26, the question resolves 'No'. Resolution will be based on the official Ryder Cup website (https://www.rydercup.com) or ESPN golf leaderboards (https://www.espn.com/golf/).
subquestions.rationale: Winning the opening session of the Ryder Cup is a critical early indicator of team form, strategy, and momentum. If Team USA secures an outright win in the Friday morning session, it will strongly increase the probability that they will win the entire 2025 Ryder Cup. Conversely, a poor start would negatively update forecasts for their ultimate victory.

subquestions.question: Will the United States officially confirm conducting a kinetic military strike on Iranian territory between February 5, 2026, and February 26, 2026?
subquestions.background_information:
Iran is currently experiencing widespread anti-government protests, severe economic instability, and a violent government crackdown that has reportedly led to thousands of deaths [https://www.news.com.au/world/middle-east/iranian-leader-hiding-son-left-in-charge]. Amid this unrest, the United States has deployed significant naval forces to the Middle East, including the USS Abraham Lincoln carrier group. U.S. leadership has threatened military action if the violent crackdown continues, with officials noting a 'massive flotilla' heading toward the region [https://www.republicworld.com/world-news/middle-east/khamenei-reportedly-sheltering-in-underground-bunker-as-us-naval-forces-head-to-middle-east]. Due to fears of a U.S. military strike, Iranian Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei has reportedly relocated to a fortified underground bunker in Tehran and delegated day-to-day governance to his son, Masoud [https://www.breitbart.com/middle-east/2026/01/26/report-irans-khamenei-flees-to-fortified-bunker-fearing-u-s-strike]. A U.S. kinetic strike on Iranian soil would represent a massive escalation that could destabilize the regime and precipitate Khamenei's removal or flight.

Sources:
News.com.au - Iranian leader hiding, son left in charge: https://www.news.com.au/world/middle-east/iranian-leader-hiding-son-left-in-charge
Republic World - Khamenei Reportedly Sheltering in Underground Bunker: https://www.republicworld.com/world-news/middle-east/khamenei-reportedly-sheltering-in-underground-bunker-as-us-naval-forces-head-to-middle-east
Breitbart - Report: Iran's Khamenei Flees to 'Fortified' Bunker: https://www.breitbart.com/middle-east/2026/01/26/report-irans-khamenei-flees-to-fortified-bunker-fearing-u-s-strike
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if the United States government officially confirms that U.S. military forces have conducted a kinetic strike (e.g., using aircraft, drones, or missiles) against a target located within the internationally recognized land territory or territorial waters of Iran between 2026-02-05 and 2026-02-26 (inclusive).

To resolve Yes, the official confirmation must be issued by the US Department of Defense (DoD), US Central Command (CENTCOM), or the White House via an official press release, public statement, or press briefing published on their respective official websites (https://www.defense.gov/, https://www.centcom.mil/, or https://www.whitehouse.gov/) within the resolution window.

The strike itself must occur between 2026-02-05 and 2026-02-26. Non-kinetic actions (such as cyberattacks or electronic warfare), or strikes on Iranian proxies, personnel, or assets located outside of Iran's internationally recognized borders (e.g., in Syria, Iraq, Yemen, or international waters) will not count for a Yes resolution. If no such official confirmation of a qualifying strike is made by the U.S. government between 2026-02-05 and 2026-02-26, the question will resolve No. If the event is postponed or confirmation is delayed beyond 2026-02-26, the question resolves No.
subquestions.rationale: The possibility of a US military strike is cited as the primary reason Ayatollah Ali Khamenei has reportedly relocated to an underground bunker and delegated daily powers to his son. A kinetic U.S. strike would severely test the regime's grip on power during ongoing mass protests, dramatically increasing the probability that Khamenei loses his position or is forced to flee (e.g., to Russia). Tracking the materialization of this specific threat provides a strong early indicator of the conditions required for the ultimate question to resolve 'No' (meaning Khamenei is out).

question: Will Giannis Antetokounmpo not be traded?
description:

If Giannis Antetokounmpo is cut, retires, is not on an NBA roster as of the resolution date, or otherwise remains on the Bucks through the NBA trade deadline, this market will resolve to "Not Traded".

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the Milwaukee Bucks and/or the acquiring team; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

subquestions.question: Will the Milwaukee Bucks have a regular season win percentage of .500 or higher at the end of the day on January 3, 2026?
subquestions.background_information:
The Milwaukee Bucks started the 2025-2026 season with a disappointing 9-13 record (.409 win percentage), placing them 11th in the Eastern Conference as of early December. This poor start has fueled intense speculation regarding the future of star player Giannis Antetokounmpo, who recently removed team references from his social media profiles. According to reports, Antetokounmpo's primary focus is competing for championships, and the team's current performance has prompted meetings between his representatives and the Bucks' front office. The Bucks face a critical schedule window between late December and early January to improve their standing before a brutal late-January slate. A key threshold for demonstrating competitiveness is returning to a .500 win percentage. If the Bucks fail to improve their standing, the pressure to trade Antetokounmpo before the February 2026 deadline will escalate significantly.

Sources:
NBA Official Standings: https://www.nba.com/standings
Milwaukee Bucks ESPN Home: https://www.espn.com/nba/team/_/name/mil/milwaukee-bucks
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if the Milwaukee Bucks officially hold a regular season win percentage of .500 or higher (e.g., 18 wins and 18 losses, 19 wins and 18 losses, etc.) at the conclusion of all scheduled NBA games on 2026-01-03. The window during which qualifying events (games played) count toward resolution is between 2025-12-04 and 2026-01-03 (inclusive). Resolution will be determined by the official NBA standings published at https://www.nba.com/standings.
