The ISW interactive map (https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375) shades the entirety of Novoekonomichne's built-up area red (indicating Russian control), or the ISW publishes a written daily campaign assessment on https://www.understandingwar.org/ explicitly stating that Russian forces have captured the entirety of Novoekonomichne.

If neither source confirms the full capture of the settlement by September 25, 2025, 11:59 PM ET, the question resolves "No". If one source confirms it but the other does not, the question resolves "Yes" based on the first reliable confirmation. In the event of temporary map glitches or rollbacks that are corrected within 48 hours, the corrected version of the map will be used.
subquestions.rationale: Novoekonomichne is a contested settlement on the immediate eastern approach to Myrnohrad. Its complete capture is a practical prerequisite and a strong proxy for Russia's ability to maintain enough offensive momentum to push into Myrnohrad proper and capture the specified intersection (Vatutina and Puhachova) by the end of September.

question: Will Ghislaine Maxwell testify before Congress in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Ghislaine Maxwell provides live or recorded testimony before either chamber of the United States Congress (House of Representatives or Senate), or any of their official committees or subcommittees by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source will be a consensus of credible reporting.

subquestions.question: Will a US Congressional committee or Ghislaine Maxwell's legal team publicly announce an agreement for her to testify before Congress by October 31, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
In July 2025, the US House Committee on Oversight and Accountability subpoenaed Ghislaine Maxwell to testify regarding Jeffrey Epstein's sex trafficking network. However, Maxwell's attorneys stated she would invoke her Fifth Amendment rights unless several demands were met, such as being granted formal immunity, receiving questions in advance, and moving the deposition outside her prison facility (CNN, https://www.cnn.com/2025/07/29/politics/maxwell-offers-testify-congress-immunity/index.html). Congressional members have been hesitant to grant immunity, leading to a legal and political standoff. Additionally, the Department of Justice announced intentions to meet privately with Maxwell, adding another layer of complexity to her potential Congressional appearance (WSET, https://wset.com/news/nation-world/gop-might-anger-trump-in-bid-to-subpoena-ghislaine-maxwell-amid-epstein-files-spectacle). Reaching a formal agreement on these conditions is generally seen as a necessary precursor for any substantive testimony to occur.

Sources:
CNN: https://www.cnn.com/2025/07/29/politics/maxwell-offers-testify-congress-immunity/index.html
WSET: https://wset.com/news/nation-world/gop-might-anger-trump-in-bid-to-subpoena-ghislaine-maxwell-amid-epstein-files-spectacle
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if either of the following conditions occurs between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 (inclusive):
1. A US Congressional committee (from either the House or Senate), its leadership, or Ghislaine Maxwell's legal representatives publicly announce that an agreement has been reached for Maxwell to provide testimony or answer substantive questions before a Congressional committee.
2. Ghislaine Maxwell provides live or recorded testimony to a Congressional committee where she answers substantive questions without exclusively invoking her Fifth Amendment rights.

To count toward resolution, the qualifying event must occur and be publicly reported between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31. Evidence must come from official Congressional press releases (e.g., https://oversight.house.gov/) or reports from at least two credible news organizations (e.g., Reuters (https://www.reuters.com/), AP News (https://apnews.com/), or CNN (https://www.cnn.com/)). If neither condition is met within this time window, or if an agreement is only announced after 2025-10-31, the question resolves No. If Maxwell appears before Congress during this window but exclusively pleads the Fifth Amendment to substantive questions, and no agreement to answer questions is otherwise announced, the question resolves No.
subquestions.rationale: Maxwell has made her testimony conditional on significant concessions from Congress, most notably immunity. The announcement of an agreement between her lawyers and Congress is a distinct, critical milestone that would serve as a strong leading indicator of her actually providing substantive testimony. Resolving this crux early provides major evidence regarding whether she will overcome the Fifth Amendment hurdle and testify before the ultimate resolution date.

subquestions.question: Will the US Department of State announce an 'Ordered Departure' or 'Authorized Departure' for US government personnel in Colombia or Mexico between January 6, 2026, and February 5, 2026?
subquestions.background_information: On January 3, 2026, the US executed a military strike on Venezuela, capturing President Maduro. Following the operation, President Trump threatened further military intervention against Colombia and Mexico, citing drug trafficking and regional security issues (https://www.nasdaq.com/). Colombian President Gustavo Petro responded by threatening armed defense of his nation's sovereignty (https://www.zerohedge.com/). Historically, before initiating military strikes or entering high-risk security environments, the US Department of State issues an 'Authorized Departure' or 'Ordered Departure' to evacuate non-emergency diplomatic personnel and their families. Tracking whether the US evacuates its diplomatic missions in Colombia or Mexico is a highly informative crux for whether a military strike on those countries is imminent. Sources: NASDAQ: Gold Skyrockets As U.S. Operation In Venezuela Triggers Safe-Haven Demand (https://www.nasdaq.com/) | Zero Hedge: US stocks gained amid softer yields... (https://www.zerohedge.com/) | US Department of State Travel Advisories (https://travel.state.gov/)
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves 'Yes' if the US Department of State officially announces an 'Authorized Departure' or 'Ordered Departure' for any US direct-hire personnel or their eligible family members from any US embassy or consulate in Colombia or Mexico between 2026-01-06 and 2026-02-05 (inclusive). The announcement must be published on the official US Embassy websites for Colombia (https://co.usembassy.gov/) or Mexico (https://mx.usembassy.gov/), or the US Department of State's official Travel Advisory page (https://travel.state.gov/). If the departure order applies only to specific regions within Mexico but is officially issued by the State Department, it still counts toward a 'Yes' resolution. Routine reassignments or expulsions of diplomats by the host country (persona non grata) do not count unless accompanied by a State Department departure order. If no such departure is authorized or ordered between 2026-01-06 and 2026-02-05, the question resolves 'No'.
subquestions.rationale: A sudden withdrawal of diplomatic personnel (via Authorized or Ordered Departure) is a standard precursor to military conflict, as the US acts to protect its staff from retaliation or collateral damage. Since the ultimate question asks about strikes on Colombia or Mexico (among others), monitoring the diplomatic posture in these two highly threatened nations provides a strong early signal. If the US orders personnel out, the probability of a strike occurring before March 2026 increases significantly.

subquestions.question: Will Elon Musk's X account (@elonmusk) reply to, repost, or quote any post from Nikita Bier (@nikitabier) between October 15, 2025 and November 14, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
Nikita Bier was appointed as the Head of Product at X in July 2025. A prolific poster, Bier noted that he "posted his way to the top" and secured the role after repeatedly interacting with Elon Musk on the platform since 2022 (Business Insider). However, shortly after his appointment, rumors surfaced that he had been fired following a controversial tweet regarding X's AI chatbot Grok, which reportedly drew Musk's ire (Futurism). Despite these rumors, Bier remained active and announced platform updates as recently as September 2025 (Mashable). Given that Bier's recruitment and professional dynamic with Musk have been heavily rooted in their public interactions on X, tracking Musk's continued public engagement with Bier serves as a useful barometer for their working relationship.

Sources:
Business Insider: https://www.businessinsider.com
Futurism: https://futurism.com
Mashable: https://mashable.com
TechCrunch: https://techcrunch.com
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if the official X account of Elon Musk (@elonmusk, https://x.com/elonmusk) replies to, reposts (retweets), or quote-tweets any post authored by the X account of Nikita Bier (@nikitabier, https://x.com/nikitabier) between 2025-10-15 and 2025-11-14 (inclusive).

The interaction must occur between 00:00:00 UTC on 2025-10-15 and 23:59:59 UTC on 2025-11-14. If an interaction occurs within this window but is subsequently deleted, it will still count towards a Yes resolution provided there is credible evidence (e.g., public web archives, screenshots from reliable news sources, or direct observation by trusted resolvers before deletion) that the event took place.

If @elonmusk does not reply to, repost, or quote any post from @nikitabier during this period, the question resolves No. If either account is suspended, deleted, or otherwise completely inaccessible for the entirety of the resolution window, preventing any interactions, the question resolves No.

Primary resolution sources will be the official X platform (https://x.com), supplemented by web archives such as the Internet Archive (https://archive.org) and credible media reports.
subquestions.rationale: Nikita Bier secured his executive position largely through his prolific posting and public interactions with Elon Musk on X. A complete cessation of public engagement from Musk toward Bier's account over a month-long period would be a strong leading indicator of internal friction, alienation, or an impending departure. Conversely, continued interaction signals a healthy, intact working relationship.

question: Will Giannis Antetokounmpo be traded this season?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed NBA player is traded from their current team to another NBA team before the 2025-2026 NBA trade deadline. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The NBA trade deadline for the 2025-2026 season is scheduled for February 5, 2026.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the NBA; however a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

subquestions.question: Will there be credible reporting that Giannis Antetokounmpo has formally requested a trade from the Milwaukee Bucks between December 4, 2025, and January 3, 2026?
subquestions.background_information:
Giannis Antetokounmpo's future with the Milwaukee Bucks has become a major focal point of the 2025-2026 NBA season. The Bucks have struggled early on, posting a 9-13 record. Recently, Antetokounmpo removed nearly all Bucks-related content from his social media accounts, sparking widespread trade speculation. According to reports from ESPN, Antetokounmpo and his agent, Alex Saratsis, have initiated discussions with the Bucks regarding his long-term fit, with a resolution expected soon. Although Antetokounmpo is under contract, a formal trade request would force Milwaukee's hand ahead of the February 5, 2026 NBA trade deadline. Determining whether Giannis applies direct pressure via a trade request is a critical early indicator of an impending blockbuster move.

Sources:
ESPN NBA: https://www.espn.com/nba/
Bleacher Report NBA: https://bleacherreport.com/nba
RealGM NBA News: https://basketball.realgm.com/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-12-04 and 2026-01-03 (inclusive), a credible sports news outlet (such as ESPN, The Athletic, Bleacher Report, or Yahoo Sports) or one of their verified lead NBA reporters publishes a report stating that Giannis Antetokounmpo or his representatives have formally requested or demanded a trade from the Milwaukee Bucks. To qualify, the report must definitively state that a trade request or demand has been communicated to the team's front office. General speculation, rumors of dissatisfaction, or reports stating he is merely 'open to a trade' do not qualify. Direct public statements from Giannis Antetokounmpo or his agent confirming a trade request between 2025-12-04 and 2026-01-03 also qualify for a Yes resolution. If no such qualifying report or statement is made by 2026-01-03 at 23:59:59 UTC, the question resolves No. Note that if Antetokounmpo is traded during this window without a qualifying report of a prior or simultaneous trade request, this question will resolve No, as it strictly tracks the reporting of a request. Verification will rely on official articles and verified social media posts from authoritative outlets.

Primary resolution sources:
ESPN: https://www.espn.com/nba/
The Athletic: https://theathletic.com/nba/
Yahoo Sports: https://sports.yahoo.com/nba/
subquestions.rationale: A formal trade request is the clearest early indicator of an impending blockbuster trade in the NBA. Superstars of Giannis Antetokounmpo's caliber are rarely traded mid-season unless they explicitly apply pressure on the front office. Resolving whether a request is made a month before the trade deadline acts as a strong crux: if he demands a trade, the probability of an actual trade by February 5 skyrockets. If he does not, the Bucks are highly likely to wait until the offseason to assess their options, thereby drastically lowering the probability of the ultimate outcome.

subquestions.question: Will there be an official announcement or credible reporting that Amazon has submitted a formal bid to acquire Warner Bros. Discovery between 2025-10-24 and 2025-11-23?
subquestions.background_information: Warner Bros. WBD CEO David Zaslav has reportedly been courting major tech companies, including Amazon, Apple, and Netflix, to instigate a bidding war and maximize shareholder value. question: Will Italy win the third most gold medals in the 2026 Winter Olympics?
description:
This market will resolve according to the country that wins the third most gold medals at the 2026 Milano-Cortina Winter Olympics, scheduled for February 6-22, 2026.

In the case of ties, the ordered list for most gold medals won will use most overall medals won as a tiebreaker (e.g. If Norway and China tie for most gold medals won, and Norway wins more overall medals than China, Norway will be ranked first and China will be second). If this also results in a tie, the country whose name comes first in alphabetical order, as listed in this market group, will be ranked higher.

This market will resolve based on the medal figures as they stand after medals are awarded for the final event in the 2026 Milano-Cortina Winter Olympics. Later changes to medal counts will not be considered toward the resolution of this market.

If the 2026 Milano-Cortina Winter Olympics are partially completed and then cancelled or postponed after December 31, 2026, this market will resolve based on the gold medals awarded in the completed events. If the 2026 Milano-Cortina Winter Olympics are entirely cancelled or postponed after December 31, 2026, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The resolution source will be official information from the International Olympic Committee (https://www.olympics.com/).

subquestions.question: Will Italy reach a cumulative total of at least 4 gold medals in the 2026 Winter Olympics by February 16, 2026?
subquestions.background_information:
The 2026 Winter Olympics are taking place in Milano-Cortina, Italy, from February 4 to February 22, 2026. For the host nation to secure the third most gold medals, they would need an exceptionally strong performance, likely surpassing traditional powerhouses like Canada, Switzerland, and either the US or Germany, who are heavily favored behind Norway. In the 2022 Beijing Games, the third-place nations (USA and China) won 9 gold medals each. Historically, host nations enjoy a medal bump; Italy won 5 gold medals when they previously hosted the Winter Games in Turin 2006 (https://olympics.com/en/olympic-games/torino-2006/medals). Tracking Italy's total gold medal count by the midpoint of the Games provides a crucial indicator of whether they possess the momentum to challenge for a top-3 finish.

Sources:
IOC - Turin 2006 Medal Table: https://olympics.com/en/olympic-games/torino-2006/medals

subquestions.question: Will NASA successfully complete a wet dress rehearsal for the Artemis II mission before February 16, 2026?
subquestions.background_information:
NASA rolled out the Artemis II Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and Orion spacecraft to Launch Pad 39B at the Kennedy Space Center on January 17, 2026. The next critical milestone before the crewed launch is a 'wet dress rehearsal' (WDR). During the WDR, the rocket is fully loaded with super-cold cryogenic propellants (liquid hydrogen and liquid oxygen) and the launch team simulates a full countdown sequence. The WDR is currently targeted for on or around February 2, 2026. According to NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman, no official launch date will be announced until the WDR is successfully completed. A successful WDR is a strict prerequisite for the mission. Delays or failures during the WDR, such as the hydrogen leaks experienced during the Artemis I campaign, could require the rocket to be rolled back to the Vehicle Assembly Building (VAB) and push the launch out of the February window. Thus, completing the WDR by mid-February is a crucial indicator for whether the Artemis II mission can launch by the end of February.

Sources:
NASA Artemis Blog: https://blogs.nasa.gov/artemis/
CBS News Space: https://www.cbsnews.com/space/
SciTechDaily Space News: https://scitechdaily.com/news/space/
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if NASA officially announces the successful completion of a wet dress rehearsal (WDR) for the Artemis II mission between 2026-01-21 and 2026-02-16T00:00:00Z (inclusive). A 'successful completion' is defined as NASA confirming that they have loaded the Space Launch System (SLS) with cryogenic propellants, executed the simulated countdown sequence to the planned cutoff point, and declared the test complete such that no additional full WDR is required before launch. Resolution will be determined by official press releases, blog posts, or video statements from NASA (e.g., https://blogs.nasa.gov/artemis/ or https://www.nasa.gov/). If NASA requires an additional WDR that is not completed by the end date, or if the test is postponed past the resolution window, the question resolves No. If NASA formally cancels the WDR requirement entirely and clears the vehicle for launch within the resolution window, this will also resolve as Yes.
subquestions.rationale: The wet dress rehearsal is the most critical hurdle remaining before the Artemis II launch. Artemis I experienced multiple WDR failures and rollback delays due to propellant leaks. Successfully passing the WDR by mid-February is a strong indicator of whether the vehicle is healthy enough to launch before February 28. If the WDR fails or is delayed past this date, a February launch becomes highly improbable due to the time required to analyze data, address anomalies, and reset ground systems.

Transporting Yoon to another location of custody (e.g., a different prison, court, or hospital within the correctional system) will not suffice to resolve this market to "Yes".

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from government authorities or corrections departments; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

subquestions.question: Will former South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol appear in person at any court hearing between October 31, 2025, and November 30, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
Former South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol has been held in pretrial detention since July 2025 on charges related to his brief declaration of martial law in December 2024 (https://en.yna.co.kr/). As of late October 2025, Yoon has engaged in a 'judicial boycott', refusing to attend his trial sessions at the Seoul Central District Court. He had accumulated over 15 consecutive absences by October 21, 2025, and the court has been proceeding with his trial in absentia because the Seoul Detention Center could not forcibly bring him in (https://www.thehansindia.com/). On October 2, 2025, the court denied Yoon's request for bail, citing the risk of evidence destruction and his repeated failure to appear at trial (https://www.donga.com/). Yoon's cooperation with the judicial process, such as ending his boycott and attending court, is a crucial indicator of his legal strategy and could influence future decisions by the court regarding his release or bail before the end of 2025.

Sources:
Court denies bail for former President Yoon - https://www.donga.com/
South Korea: Ex-President Yoon absent from 2nd martial law trial for 3rd straight session - https://www.thehansindia.com/
Court rejects ex-President Yoon's request for bail - https://en.yna.co.kr/
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if credible news reports or official court records confirm that former South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol physically attended at least one court hearing (e.g., a trial session, bail hearing, or warrant review) in person between 2025-10-31 and 2025-11-30 (inclusive). Attendance requires his physical presence inside the courtroom. If he continues to be tried in absentia for all scheduled hearings, or if no hearings occur during this time frame, the question resolves No. The primary resolution sources will be official announcements from the Seoul Central District Court (https://seoul.scourt.go.kr/) and consensus reporting from reliable English or Korean-language media outlets, such as Yonhap News Agency (https://en.yna.co.kr/) or KBS WORLD Radio (https://world.kbs.co.kr/). Delayed or postponed hearings that occur outside the resolution window will not count toward a Yes resolution.
subquestions.rationale: Yoon's ongoing 'judicial boycott' is a major factor in the court's refusal to grant him bail or release him from pretrial detention. The special prosecutor has explicitly cited his repeated absences as a reason for maintaining strict measures against him. If Yoon decides to physically appear in court, it would represent a significant shift in his legal strategy toward cooperation, which is likely a prerequisite for the court to favorably reconsider any future requests for bail or release by the end of 2025. Thus, his court attendance acts as an important early indicator of his prospects for leaving custody.

subquestions.question: Will Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive officially announce pre-orders for Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA VI) between October 31, 2025 and November 25, 2025?

Rumors and fan speculation have heavily focused on this November timeframe, with many expecting Rockstar Games to release a new trailer or announce pre-orders around November 8, 2025, marking the two-year anniversary since the announcement of the first trailer (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/international/us/gta-6-fans-excited-over-1108-clue-will-trailer-3-drop-on-november-8/articleshow/10456789.cms).

As of October 31, 2025, GTA 6 is officially scheduled to release on May 26, 2026, yet pre-orders have not officially commenced. If Take-Two or Rockstar announces the start of pre-orders in November, it is a very strong indicator that a new trailer will be released before the end of 2025 to drive holiday sales. Conversely, if no pre-orders are announced, the likelihood of a major promotional trailer dropping in late 2025 diminishes.

Sources:

The Economic Times - GTA 6 speculation: https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/international/us/gta-6-fans-excited-over-1108-clue-will-trailer-3-drop-on-november-8/articleshow/10456789.cms

subquestions.resolution_criteria:

The announcement must be published on at least one of the following official channels:
1. The Rockstar Games Newswire (https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire)

- Mentions of third-party retailers (e.g., GameStop, Best Buy) offering unofficial or placeholder pre-orders do not count towards a Yes resolution unless corroborated by an official announcement from Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.
- The announcement must apply to the actual video game (e.g., Standard, Special, or Collector's editions). Announcements exclusively for GTA VI merchandise (clothing, collectibles without the game) do not count.

subquestions.rationale: The opening of pre-orders is a critical milestone in a video game's marketing cycle. Because major game publishers typically release high-profile trailers to drive pre-order sales, an announcement of GTA VI pre-orders in November strongly correlates with the release of a new trailer before the end of 2025. Tracking this event provides forecasters with an observable, high-value indicator of Rockstar's near-term promotional strategy for the game, without simply restating the ultimate question with an earlier deadline.

question: Will 'Zootopia 2' have the second best domestic opening weekend in 2025?
description:
This is a market on how whether 'Zootopia 2' (2025) will have the second-highest domestic gross on its opening weekend compared to all other movies released in 2025. Please note, this market will resolve according to the The Numbers figures provided under Weekend Box Office Performance for the 3-day weekend, regardless of whether domestic refers to only the USA, or to USA and Canada, etc.

Resolution will be based specifically on the figures provided for this movie's 3-day opening weekend (Friday, Saturday, Sunday), regardless of whether the movie has a 4 or 5-day opening weekend.

If two other movies' opening weekend box office performances surpass that of 'Zootopia 2' (2025) after the respective numbers are finalized, this market may immediately resolve to "No".

If this movie's opening weekend box office performance ties with any other's, the movie whose title comes first in alphabetical order will rank higher.

If there is no final data available by January 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, another credible resolution source will be chosen.

subquestions.question: Will 'Wicked: For Good' gross at least $130,000,000 in its domestic 3-day opening weekend?
subquestions.background_information:
In 2025, several highly anticipated movies have achieved massive domestic opening weekends, crowding the top box office rankings. According to reports, 'A Minecraft Movie' debuted to $162 million, and 'Lilo & Stitch' opened to $141 million. Disney's 'Zootopia 2' is projected to earn between $95 million and $130 million during its opening weekend starting November 26, 2025. However, just before 'Zootopia 2' arrives in theaters, Universal's 'Wicked: For Good' will debut on November 21, 2025. Early projections for 'Wicked: For Good' range from $112 million up to $190 million. Because 'Zootopia 2' needs to secure exactly the second-highest domestic opening weekend of 2025 to resolve the ultimate question as 'Yes', the performance of 'Wicked: For Good' serves as a massive crux. If 'Wicked: For Good' grosses $130 million or more, 'Zootopia 2' would face a much steeper uphill battle to claim the #2 spot, as it would likely need to surpass both 'Wicked: For Good' and 'Lilo & Stitch' ($141M). 

Sources:
BoxOfficePro: https://www.boxofficepro.com
The Numbers: https://www.the-numbers.com
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to 'Yes' if the final reported 3-day domestic opening weekend box office gross (Friday, Saturday, Sunday) for 'Wicked: For Good' is $130,000,000 or greater. Resolution will be based on the official 'Weekend Box Office Performance' data published by The Numbers (https://www.the-numbers.com) or, if unavailable, Box Office Mojo (https://www.boxofficemojo.com). Studio estimates do not count; the official final weekend actuals must be used. To count toward resolution, the qualifying opening weekend event and the publication of the final box office numbers must occur between the start_date of 2025-10-31 and the end_date of 2025-11-28 (inclusive). If the film is delayed beyond this window or the final numbers are not published by the end_date, the question resolves as 'Unresolved'.
subquestions.rationale: For 'Zootopia 2' to have the second-best domestic opening weekend of 2025, it must slot perfectly behind the number one film (currently 'A Minecraft Movie' at $162M) and ahead of all others, including 'Lilo & Stitch' ($141M). If 'Wicked: For Good', which opens one week before 'Zootopia 2', grosses $130 million or more, it further saturates the top tiers of the 2025 box office. Since 'Zootopia 2' is currently tracking between $95M and $130M, a massive opening for 'Wicked' would severely reduce the statistical likelihood of 'Zootopia 2' taking the #2 rank, providing forecasters with a strong early indicator to update their ultimate predictions.

subquestions.question: Will at least one of John Cornyn or Ken Paxton publicly agree to participate in a primary debate with Wesley Hunt between November 26, 2025, and December 26, 2025?

As of late November, no debate has been officially scheduled, though polling has remained tight with no clear frontrunner emerging (https://www.cbsnews.com/texas/news/texas-sen-john-cornyn-locked-in-close-polling-with-ag-ken-paxton-and-rep-wesley-hunt/).

Yahoo News: https://www.yahoo.com/news/wesley-hunt-enters-2026-texas-173646011.html
Yahoo News: https://www.yahoo.com/news/polls-tighten-wesley-hunt-enters-140000305.html
Yahoo News: https://www.yahoo.com/news/hunt-calls-debate-cornyn-paxton-184500912.html

subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-11-26 and 2025-12-26 (inclusive), the official campaign of either John Cornyn or Ken Paxton (or both) publicly confirms their agreement to participate in a Texas Republican primary debate that also includes Wesley Hunt as a participant. 

The agreement must be made publicly via an official campaign press release, an official candidate social media account, or be confirmed by a credible news organization (such as The Texas Tribune: https://www.texastribune.org/, or The Dallas Morning News: https://www.dallasnews.com/). The agreement must be for a debate scheduled to occur before the Texas primary election on March 3, 2026.

If neither Cornyn nor Paxton publicly agrees to a debate including Hunt between 2025-11-26 and 2025-12-26, or if they explicitly decline all such debates during this window, this question resolves No. If an agreement is announced within the resolution window but the debate is subsequently canceled, the question still resolves Yes as long as the initial agreement was officially and publicly confirmed during the specified timeframe.
subquestions.rationale: Wesley Hunt's ability to avoid a 3rd place finish depends heavily on raising his profile to match the near-universal name recognition of Cornyn and Paxton. Getting the frontrunners to share a debate stage with him is a critical step in overcoming this gap. If Cornyn or Paxton agree to debate Hunt, it signals they view his polling as a legitimate threat, increasing his odds of breaking out of 3rd place. If they ignore his October 30th challenge entirely, it suggests they believe they can safely starve his campaign of oxygen, making a 3rd place finish much more likely.

question: Fed governor resigns by October 31?
description:

subquestions.question: Will Fed Governor Lisa Cook be listed as a voting member in the official FOMC statement for the September 2025 meeting?
subquestions.background_information:
On August 26, 2025, President Donald Trump claimed to have fired Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook over alleged mortgage fraud (https://www.morningstar.com/news/morning-headlines-trump-removing-fed-governor-lisa-cook). Cook has publicly refused to step down, stating that the President lacks the legal authority to remove her and that she will not resign (https://wtop.com/national/2025/08/the-latest-fed-governor-wont-leave-saying-trump-lacks-authority-to-fire-her/). While Cook's legal team prepares to fight the dismissal, White House officials have suggested she should be placed on administrative leave until the matter is resolved (https://edition.cnn.com/2025/08/28/economy/inside-trumps-attempt-to-put-his-mark-on-the-fed/index.html). The next Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting is scheduled for September 16-17, 2025. As a member of the Board of Governors, Cook is a permanent voting member of the FOMC. Whether she is permitted to vote at this meeting will serve as a clear indicator of her current status and whether she is successfully holding her position.

Sources:
Morningstar: Dow Jones Top Markets Headlines at 3 AM ET - https://www.morningstar.com/news/morning-headlines-trump-removing-fed-governor-lisa-cook
WTOP News: The Latest: Fed governor won't leave - https://wtop.com/national/2025/08/the-latest-fed-governor-wont-leave-saying-trump-lacks-authority-to-fire-her/
CNN International: 'We just jumped into the unknown:' Inside Trump's attempt to put his mark on the Fed - https://edition.cnn.com/2025/08/28/economy/inside-trumps-attempt-to-put-his-mark-on-the-fed/index.html
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if the official Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) statement released following the September 2025 meeting explicitly lists Lisa Cook (or Lisa D. Cook) as having voted on the monetary policy action, and this statement is published between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01 (inclusive).

The primary resolution source will be the official FOMC press release published on the Federal Reserve's website (https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm).

Specifically, resolvers should review the paragraph in the statement that records the votes, which typically begins with 'Voting for the monetary policy action were...' or 'Voting against the action...'. If Lisa Cook's name appears in either of these lists, the question resolves Yes.

If she is listed as absent, abstaining, not listed at all, or if the FOMC statement is not released within the specified window (between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01), the question resolves No.
subquestions.rationale: Lisa Cook's participation in the September 16-17, 2025 FOMC meeting is a critical observable event for predicting her potential resignation. Following President Trump's unprecedented attempt to fire her and her refusal to step down, her ability to cast a vote on monetary policy will prove whether she has maintained her active status on the Board of Governors. If she is listed as a voting member, it indicates she has successfully resisted removal and has not been forced onto administrative leave or pressured into resigning ahead of the meeting. This would significantly lower the probability of her resigning by the October 31 ultimate deadline. Conversely, if she does not vote, it strongly suggests she has either resigned, been legally suspended, or conceded her position, making a formal resignation announcement much more likely.

question: Will Russia capture Lyman by November 30?

subquestions.question: Will Russian forces capture any part of Zarichne (Donetsk Oblast) by November 15, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
Lyman is a critical railway hub and strategic city in Donetsk Oblast, Ukraine. The primary Russian axis of advance toward Lyman from the east typically routes through the settlements of Torske and Zarichne, which lie directly on the T0530 and O0527 highways. Currently, the active front line in this sector is situated just east of Zarichne. For Russian forces to realistically reach and capture the Lyman railway station (located centrally within Lyman) by late November, they would almost certainly need to first penetrate or capture the adjacent settlement of Zarichne, which sits less than 5 kilometers from Lyman's eastern outskirts. Tracking the status of Zarichne serves as a strong leading indicator: if Zarichne falls or is entered by mid-November, the immediate threat to Lyman city proper and its railway station increases significantly. 

Sources:
Institute for the Study of War (ISW) Interactive Map: https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375
DeepStateMap: https://deepstatemap.live/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves 'Yes' if, between 2025-10-22 and 2025-11-15 (inclusive), the primary Institute for the Study of War (ISW) interactive map (https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375) shades any part of the settlement of Zarichne (Lyman Hromada, Donetsk Oblast, located at approximately 49°01'N 37°55'E) as 'Assessed Russian Advance' (red shading). 

The area of Zarichne will be defined by its recognizable residential and municipal footprint on the base map used by ISW. If the ISW map is rendered permanently unavailable or ceases updates, the DeepStateMap (https://deepstatemap.live/) will be used as the primary fallback, resolving 'Yes' if any part of Zarichne's settlement boundaries is shaded red (indicating Russian control) during the resolution window.

If neither source shows any part of Zarichne as captured by Russia by 11:59 PM ET on 2025-11-15, the question will resolve 'No'. Once the criteria for a 'Yes' resolution are met, any subsequent loss of control by Russian forces will not affect the resolution. Temporary map glitches or artifacts that are corrected within 48 hours will not count toward resolution.
subquestions.rationale: Zarichne is a vital geographical stepping stone located just east of Lyman. If Russian forces are unable to reach or capture any part of Zarichne by mid-November, their capability to mount an assault on Lyman and capture its centrally located train station by November 30 is highly improbable. Conversely, an established Russian presence in Zarichne strongly correlates with an imminent push into Lyman, making it an excellent early indicator for the ultimate question.

question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $110 by end of June?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if, on any trading day, the official CME settlement price for the Active Month (front month) of Silver (SI) futures is equal to or above the listed price by the final trading day of June 2026. Otherwise, the market will resolve to "No".

For CME Silver (SI) futures contracts, the Active Month is the nearest of CME's designated delivery-cycle months (March, May, July, September, December) that is not the spot month. The Active Month becomes a non-active month effective on its First Position Date, at which point the next eligible contract month becomes the Active Month.

Only the Active Month's official settlement price published by CME Group will be considered. Intraday trades, highs, lows, bids, offers, midpoint values, or indicative prices do not count.

Note that the settlement price may differ from the last traded price. CME's methodology to determine the settlement price can vary by commodity and contract.

Only days on which CME publishes an official settlement price for the Active Month will be included. Days without settlement prices (weekends, holidays, or market closures) are ignored.

This market will resolve based on the settlement price as it appears on the CME settlement page at the time it is first published for that trading day, regardless of any later corrections or updates.

The resolution source for this market is the CME Group website — specifically, the daily "Settlement" price for the Active Month of Silver (SI) futures.

subquestions.question: Will the CME Group announce an increase in margin requirements for COMEX Silver (SI) futures between December 27, 2025 and January 20, 2026?
subquestions.background_information:
Recent extreme volatility in the silver market has sparked rumors of structural stress in the COMEX physical delivery system. In late November 2025, silver futures saw dramatic price action followed by a trading halt. While the exchange attributed this to a data center 'cooling failure' (https://www.morningstar.com/news/dow-jones/20251128/cme-data-center-issue-hits-options-futures-trading-update), alternative reports suggested the halt coincided with an Authorized Participant attempting to take physical delivery of 400 million ounces of silver, exposing a massive paper short position (https://truthsocial.com/). As of early December 2025, front-month silver was trading around $59 to $62 per ounce (https://apnews.com/article/gold-silver-futures-december-2025). December 31, 2025, is viewed by some market participants as a critical deadline for derivative exposures to be settled. If silver prices are genuinely on a trajectory to reach a historic $110 by June 2026, it would require an explosive rally and severe market volatility. In response to such unprecedented volatility and to protect the clearinghouse from default risks, the CME Group frequently increases margin requirements (performance bonds) for futures contracts. Therefore, an official increase in silver futures margin requirements by the CME Group in the weeks following the critical year-end settlement period would serve as a strong early indicator of the exchange managing an unprecedented price spike or physical squeeze.

Sources:
AP News. "BC-Gold-Silver". https://apnews.com/article/gold-silver-futures-december-2025
Morningstar. "CME Data-Center Issue Hits Options, Futures Trading". https://www.morningstar.com/news/dow-jones/20251128/cme-data-center-issue-hits-options-futures-trading-update
Donald J. Trump. "CME's 'Cooling Failure'". https://truthsocial.com/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if the CME Group publishes an official Clearing Advisory or official notice explicitly announcing an increase in the initial or maintenance margin requirement (performance bond) for COMEX Silver (SI) futures contracts between 2025-12-27 and 2026-01-20 (inclusive).

The announcement must be published on the official CME Group website, specifically within their Clearing Advisories or Notices sections (e.g., https://www.cmegroup.com/notices/clearing.html or https://www.cmegroup.com/clearing/risk-management/clearing-advisories.html) or on the CME Margins page (https://www.cmegroup.com/clearing/risk-management/performance-bonds-margins.html) during the specified resolution window.

The margin increase must apply to the outright COMEX Silver (SI) futures contract for at least one active contract month. Intraday margin increases, maintenance margin increases, or initial margin increases all qualify, provided they represent a definitive numerical increase from the margin levels in effect immediately preceding the announcement.

If no such margin increase is announced for Silver (SI) futures by the CME Group between 2025-12-27 and 2026-01-20 (inclusive), the question resolves No. In the event the CME Group website is permanently unavailable during the resolution period, verifiable reporting by at least two major financial news outlets (e.g., Bloomberg at https://www.bloomberg.com, Reuters at https://www.reuters.com, or the Wall Street Journal at https://www.wsj.com) stating that CME increased silver margin requirements during the resolution window will be sufficient to resolve the question as Yes. Delayed implementations do not affect resolution as long as the announcement itself is made within the resolution window.
subquestions.rationale: A massive price surge from current levels of roughly $60 to $110 per ounce within six months would entail unprecedented volatility and potential systemic stress, as suggested by recent reports of a 400 million ounce delivery squeeze. To mitigate risk during such explosive, parabolic rallies, commodity exchanges like the CME Group invariably raise margin requirements to ensure the clearinghouse's stability (as seen historically in massive short squeezes). If silver is truly embarking on a historic run towards $110 early in the year, the CME is highly likely to proactively increase margin requirements in late December or January to curb excessive speculation and shore up systemic defenses. This makes a margin increase a highly informative, objective early indicator for the ultimate outcome.

question: Transgender women be banned from the Olympics before Winter Games?

An official declaration of a qualifying ban within the specified timeframe will suffice, regardless of whether it is later revoked. 

Only IOC-imposed bans will qualify; bans or eligibility rules issued by other authorities, such as International Federations or National Olympic Committees, will not qualify. 

The primary resolution source for this market will be official IOC communications; however, a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

subquestions.question: Will the IOC publish an official agenda, schedule, or press release confirming that athlete gender eligibility will be discussed or voted on at the pre-Winter Games meetings?

IOC President Kirsty Coventry has stated that the IOC intends to finalize and possibly announce the policy by early 2026. A decision is widely expected to be presented, discussed, or voted on during the IOC Executive Board meeting or the 145th IOC Session, both of which take place in Milan right before the Winter Games opening on February 6, 2026. subquestions.resolution_criteria:

subquestions.rationale: For a ban to be implemented prior to the Milan-Cortina Winter Olympics, the IOC will need to formally review and likely vote on the measure during its pre-Games Executive Board meeting or 145th Session. Their hesitance to endorse Mamdani highlights a divide between the progressive nominee and the moderate party establishment. Barack Obama typically waits for local and federal party unity before intervening in local races. If Schumer or Jeffries formally endorse Mamdani, it signals that the establishment firewall is breaking, strongly increasing the likelihood that Obama will feel comfortable following suit. subquestions.question: Will the United States officially announce an intent to provide strategic enabling support (such as ISR or command-and-control) to a foreign peacekeeping or reassurance force in Ukraine between September 1, 2025 and October 1, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
Recent reports indicate that European nations, particularly the UK and France, are leading discussions on the creation of a 'reassurance force' or peacekeeping mission to be deployed in Ukraine following a potential ceasefire or peace deal. According to EurActiv, a 'Coalition of the Willing' is preparing to outline this proposed force in early September 2025. However, experts and European officials emphasize that such a force heavily depends on the United States acting as a 'strategic enabler.' The Financial Times reported that the US is considering providing critical capabilities like intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR), command-and-control (C2), and air-defense assets to backstop the European mission. The Pentagon has so far characterized these discussions as 'pre-decisional' and maintained that no US ground troops will be deployed. Because many European nations lack the necessary logistical and intelligence capabilities to independently sustain a large deployment in a high-threat environment, formal US commitment of these supporting assets is widely seen as a prerequisite for European countries to finalize and announce their troop commitments.

Sources:
EurActiv - Who's in and who's out of Ukraine's 'reassurance force': https://www.euractiv.com/
Kyiv Independent - US may provide intelligence, air defense assets to European peacekeepers in Ukraine: https://kyivindependent.com/
Responsible Statecraft - Report: NATO, US heavily involved in post-war Ukrainian security: https://responsiblestatecraft.org/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01 (inclusive), the United States government officially announces or confirms its intent to provide strategic enabling support to a European-led, multinational, or third-party peacekeeping, reassurance, or buffer-zone force inside Ukraine.

Qualifying support includes, but is not limited to, intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR), command-and-control (C2), logistics, or air-defense. The commitment must be explicitly linked to a foreign troop presence or peacekeeping mission in Ukraine; general statements regarding continued military aid or support for the Ukrainian Armed Forces do not qualify.

The announcement must be made publicly via an official press release, a published policy document, or a public statement/briefing by a cabinet-level official (e.g., the President, Secretary of Defense, Secretary of State) or their official spokespersons. The primary sources for resolution will be official US government websites (https://www.defense.gov, https://www.whitehouse.gov, https://www.state.gov) and credible mainstream news reporting of such statements. 

If no qualifying announcement is made by 2025-10-01 at 11:59 PM ET, the question resolves No. If an event or announcement is delayed and occurs outside this specific window, it will not count toward a Yes resolution.
subquestions.rationale: European military planners lack the independent intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) and command-and-control (C2) capabilities required to safely operate a large-scale peacekeeping mission in a contested environment like Ukraine. Consequently, European leaders have heavily conditioned their troop commitments on the US providing this strategic 'backstop'. Forecasting whether the US officially commits to this support in the near term provides a high-value leading indicator for the ultimate question: a 'Yes' greatly increases the likelihood that EU/NATO members will confidently follow through and announce their own troop deployments, while a 'No' suggests the reassurance force may stall due to critical capability gaps.

subquestions.question: Will MrBeast's main YouTube channel reach 450 million subscribers by October 27, 2025?

subquestions.question: Will the Office of the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR) or the White House officially announce an agreement in principle or the signing of a bilateral free trade agreement with Argentina between October 31, 2025 and November 30, 2025?

To qualify, the announcement must explicitly state that negotiations have concluded, a deal has been reached, or a trade pact has been signed. Announcements of mere intent to negotiate, preliminary trade dialogues, working groups, or unrelated financial agreements (such as currency swaps) do not qualify. Delayed events: If the official announcement occurs after 2025-11-30, the question resolves No. Fall-back criteria: If either specified government website becomes permanently unavailable, credible reporting from at least two major international news outlets (e.g., Reuters: https://www.reuters.com/ or Bloomberg: https://www.bloomberg.com/) confirming that the official U.S. government announcement was made within the resolution window will suffice.

question: U.S. enacts AI safety bill in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if a bill that includes at least one of the following provisions is signed into federal law in the United States  by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. 

- Prohibition on Creation or Release: Forbids the creation or release of specific AI systems or models.

- Training Restrictions: Sets limits on how AI systems can be trained, such as restricting access to previously available training data or imposing a maximum limit on the number of parameters used for training.

- Usage Restrictions:  Prevents AI systems from being used in certain applications, such as interacting with customers, interfacing with other applications, or performing actions on the web.

- Human-in-the-Loop Requirements: Requires AI systems to include mechanisms ensuring human oversight or involvement in their operation.

Otherwise this market will resolve to "No". 

The resolution source will be official U.S. federal government (e.g., Congress.gov) however a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

subquestions.question: Will either the U.S. House of Representatives or the U.S. Senate pass a federal bill containing at least one of the specified AI safety provisions between October 1, 2025, and October 31, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
The U.S. federal government has faced mounting pressure to regulate Artificial Intelligence. In mid-2025, state-level regulations accelerated; California enacted SB 53, Illinois passed the Wellness and Oversight for Psychological Resources Act, and Texas passed SB 815, among others. Meanwhile, the Trump administration has taken a deregulatory approach to AI, rescinding Biden-era safety measures in favor of the 'AI Action Plan' intended to promote open-source AI and reduce regulatory barriers (https://www.lexology.com). Despite this, there has been bipartisan interest in AI legislation, such as the AI Accountability and Personal Data Protection Act (Hawley-Blumenthal) and the No Adversarial AI Act (Krishnamoorthi-Moolenaar) (https://www.lexology.com). Congress also recently removed a 10-year ban on state-level AI regulation from the One Big Beautiful Bill (https://wztv.com). For a federal AI safety bill to be signed into law by December 31, 2025, it would likely need to make significant legislative progress, such as passing at least one chamber of Congress by late October 2025. This subquestion tracks whether either chamber of the U.S. Congress passes a bill that includes specific AI safety provisions (Prohibition on Creation/Release, Training Restrictions, Usage Restrictions, or Human-in-the-Loop Requirements) during October 2025.

Sources:
Lexology - https://www.lexology.com
WZTV - https://wztv.com
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 (inclusive), either the U.S. House of Representatives or the U.S. Senate passes a federal bill that includes at least one of the following provisions:

1. Prohibition on Creation or Release: Forbids the creation or release of specific AI systems or models.
2. Training Restrictions: Sets limits on how AI systems can be trained, such as restricting access to previously available training data or imposing a maximum limit on the number of parameters used for training.
3. Usage Restrictions: Prevents AI systems from being used in certain applications, such as interacting with customers, interfacing with other applications, or performing actions on the web.
4. Human-in-the-Loop Requirements: Requires AI systems to include mechanisms ensuring human oversight or involvement in their operation.

The passage of the bill must occur strictly within the resolution window (between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31) and be recorded in the official Congressional Record. A bill passed by voice vote, unanimous consent, or roll call vote qualifies. Resolution will be determined by reviewing official legislative text on Congress.gov (https://www.congress.gov). If no such bill is passed by either chamber within this timeframe, the question resolves No. If a bill is passed but its text is unavailable by the end of the resolution window, credible media reporting (e.g., from The Washington Post or Reuters) confirming the inclusion of one of the specified provisions will be used. A bill merely being introduced or advanced by a committee does not count; it must pass the full floor of either chamber.
subquestions.rationale: For a major federal AI safety bill to be signed into law by the end of December 2025, the legislative process must advance significantly in the preceding months. Passing a chamber of Congress in October is a strong indicator that such a bill has the momentum necessary to pass the other chamber and reach the President's desk by the end of the year.

question: Major meteor strike (10kt+) in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if a natural meteoroid (bolide) explodes in Earth's atmosphere with a total impact energy greater or equal to 10 kilotons of TNT equivalent between May 28, and December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

The object must be classified as a natural meteoroid; events involving artificial objects or reentry vehicles do not qualify.

The primary resolution source will be the NASA JPL Fireball and Bolide Data repository: https://cneos.jpl.nasa.gov/fireballs/. The relevant field for determining impact energy is the “Impact Energy (kt)” column. If this dataset has not been updated to include all relevant dates by February 28, 2026, or if the NASA JPL Fireball and Bolide Data repository becomes permanently unavailable, this market may resolve based on a consensus of credible sources including the European Space Agency (ESA), the International Asteroid Warning Network (IAWN), the U.S. Department of Defense, or credible reporting of a scientific consensus, such as a NASA press release.

subquestions.question: Will the NASA JPL Fireball and Bolide Data repository record at least one meteor event with an impact energy of 0.1 kt or greater occurring between September 1, 2025, and October 1, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
Earth is constantly bombarded by small space debris, which burn up in the atmosphere as meteors or bolides. Their explosive energy is measured in kilotons (kt) of TNT equivalent. According to recent reports, a 1.6 kt fireball was recorded over southern Japan on August 19, 2025 (https://watchers.news), while a smaller 0.02 kt (20 tons) meteor exploded over Georgia in June 2025 (https://fark.com). Monitoring the frequency and size of these smaller impacts acts as a baseline indicator for near-Earth object activity. Furthermore, NASA's Center for Near Earth Object Studies (CNEOS) maintains the primary repository for this data (https://cneos.jpl.nasa.gov/fireballs/). Tracking whether smaller (>= 0.1 kt) events are actively recorded during September tests both the operational integrity of the database—which is the primary resolution source for the ultimate 10 kt question—and whether Earth is currently passing through any localized regions of denser space debris. 

Sources:
NASA JPL Fireball and Bolide Data: https://cneos.jpl.nasa.gov/fireballs/
Watchers News on Japan Fireball: https://watchers.news
Fark News on Georgia Meteor: https://fark.com
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if the NASA JPL Fireball and Bolide Data repository (https://cneos.jpl.nasa.gov/fireballs/) officially logs at least one event with a value of 0.1 or greater in the 'Impact Energy (kt)' column that occurs between 2025-09-01 00:00:00 UTC and 2025-10-01 00:00:00 UTC (inclusive). The occurrence date is determined strictly by the 'Date/Time (UT)' column in the dataset.

Because of natural delays in sensor data processing and reporting, resolution will be determined by checking the repository on October 15, 2025, at 12:00 PM UTC. If the specific NASA JPL dataset has not reported any qualifying event that occurred within the defined time window by this check date, or if the repository is permanently unavailable on this date, the question will resolve No. Events officially noted by CNEOS or NASA as involving artificial objects or space debris reentry are excluded.
subquestions.rationale: Tracking smaller bolide impacts (0.1 kt+) over a one-month window serves two distinct functions. First, it establishes the ongoing operational status, sensitivity, and reporting latency of the CNEOS database, which is the sole primary source for the ultimate 10kt question. Second, an elevated rate of smaller impacts could suggest Earth is passing through a denser cluster of debris, slightly elevating the probability of a larger event. Conversely, a lack of reported events might indicate a quiet period or a database reporting outage, either of which would downwardly update expectations for a positively recorded 10 kt+ event by year-end.

subquestions.question: Will FCC Chairman Brendan Carr explicitly mention Jon Stewart or 'The Daily Show' on his official X account or in an FCC press release between September 19, 2025, and October 19, 2025?

subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-09-19 and 2025-10-19 (inclusive), FCC Chairman Brendan Carr explicitly mentions 'Jon Stewart', 'Stewart' (in clear reference to Jon Stewart), or 'The Daily Show' via either of the following official channels: 1. With Jon Stewart dedicating his special September 18 episode to this exact controversy and challenging censorship, a retaliatory comment from Carr would heavily indicate escalating pressure on Paramount. Given Paramount's recent cancellation of Stephen Colbert and the uncertainty surrounding Stewart's contract, an attack from the FCC Chairman is a highly informative crux that would drastically increase the probability of Stewart's show being cancelled or him being removed before December 31.

question: Will Trump meet with Elon Musk by March 31?

subquestions.question: Will Donald Trump and Elon Musk hold a confirmed phone or video call between 2025-11-25 and 2025-12-25?

subquestions.question: Will at least one Brazilian Supreme Court Justice publicly vote to convict Jair Bolsonaro on any charges related to the coup attempt between September 1, 2025, and September 9, 2025?

Former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro is on trial before the Supreme Court (Supremo Tribunal Federal) for allegedly leading a plot to overturn the 2022 election results. Bolsonaro and his allies face multiple charges, including attempting to stage a coup and involvement in an armed criminal organization. The Supreme Court announced it will hold extraordinary sessions to rule on the case on September 2, 3, 9, 10, and 12, 2025. Justice Alexandre de Moraes is overseeing the trial as the rapporteur. During these sessions, the justices are expected to publicly read and register their individual votes. question: Will any of the stolen Louvre jewels be returned by December 31?
description:

A single item (e.g., one earring) will suffice regardless of if it is missing a diamond or other element; however, recovery of only a fragment or part of an item (for example, a loose stone or a piece of a crown) will not suffice

subquestions.question: Will authorities announce the arrest or formal charging of at least one suspect in connection with the October 2025 Louvre jewel heist between October 21 and November 20, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
On October 19-20, 2025, a highly coordinated heist at the Louvre Museum in Paris resulted in the theft of eight historic French crown jewels from the Galerie d'Apollon. The thieves, operating in under seven minutes, stole irreplaceable items such as Empress Eugénie's diadem and an emerald set once worn by Empress Marie-Louise. Art recovery experts, such as Chris Marinello, warn that without rapid police action, the jewels are highly likely to be dismantled, melted down, and recut to obscure their origins within 24 to 48 hours. Therefore, the swift identification and arrest of the perpetrators—reported to be a four-person team—is viewed as a critical step toward recovering any of the jewels intact. The Paris public prosecutor’s office is directing the investigation, with alerts issued to Interpol and neighboring countries to monitor black-market activity.

Sources:
Burglars Just Broke Into the Louvre and Stole Historic Crown Jewels in a Daring Daylight Heist - https://www.smithsonianmag.com
Expert Says Stolen Louvre Jewels Need to Be Recovered in 24-to-48 Hours Or They're 'Long Gone': Report - https://people.com
subquestions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves 'Yes' if a recognized French governmental authority (e.g., the Paris public prosecutor's office, Ministry of Justice, Ministry of Interior, or National Police), or a foreign/international law enforcement agency (e.g., Interpol, Europol), officially announces that at least one individual has been arrested, detained (placé en garde à vue), or formally charged (mis en examen) in direct connection with the October 2025 Louvre jewel heist between 2025-10-21 and 2025-11-20T23:59:59Z (inclusive). The official announcement must occur and be publicly reported within this time window. A consensus of credible reporting from major news agencies (such as Reuters: https://www.reuters.com, France 24: https://www.france24.com, or Le Monde: https://www.lemonde.fr) quoting official law enforcement statements will suffice for resolution. If an individual is originally arrested for an unrelated crime, the question will only resolve 'Yes' if they are explicitly charged or officially detained for their involvement in the Louvre heist within the specified resolution window. If no such announcement occurs between 2025-10-21 and 2025-11-20T23:59:59Z, the question resolves 'No'.
subquestions.rationale: Art recovery experts note that stolen historic jewels are typically dismantled and melted down rapidly to hide their origins and avoid detection. If authorities fail to make any arrests or identify suspects within the first month of the heist, it strongly implies the thieves have successfully escaped and fenced or destroyed the items, making the recovery of any intact jewel by the end of December highly improbable. Conversely, an early arrest increases the probability of interrogating suspects, disrupting the fencing network, and locating at least one intact piece.

question: U.S. x Iran Military Engagement by June 30, 2026?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if there is a military engagement between the military forces of the United States of America and Iran between market creation and the listed date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

A "military engagement" is defined as any incident involving the use of force such as missile strikes, artillery fire, exchange of gunfire, or other forms of direct military engagement between US and Iranian military forces. Non-violent actions, such as warning shots, artillery fire into uninhabited areas, or missile launches that land in territorial waters or pass through airspace, will not qualify for a "Yes" resolution. Intentional ship ramming that results in significant damage to (e.g., a hole in the hull) or the sinking of a military ship by another will count toward a "Yes" resolution; however, minor damage (scrapes, dents) will not. Any U.S. military kinetic strike that impacts Iranian land territory will qualify for a “Yes” resolution. 

Missiles or drones which are intercepted and surface-to-air missile strikes will not be sufficient for a "Yes" resolution, regardless of whether they land on adversarial territory or cause damage.

Note: the U.S. Coast Guard is a branch of the U.S. Armed Forces; the Iranian Law Enforcement Command is a branch of the Iranian Armed Forces; all sub-branches of the Artesh, Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (including the Basij), and Law Enforcement Command are part of the Iranian Armed forces.

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

subquestions.question: Will U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) or the Department of Defense officially announce the use of kinetic force (e.g., warning shots, drone/missile interceptions, or direct strikes) by U.S. forces against Iranian military assets between February 6, 2026, and February 25, 2026?
subquestions.background_information:
On February 4, 2026, a U.S. Navy F-35C stealth fighter jet shot down an Iranian Shahed-139 drone that aggressively approached the USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier in the Arabian Sea (Source: https://defensescoop.com/). On the same day, Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) boats and a Mohajer drone harassed the U.S.-flagged tanker M/V Stena Imperative in the Strait of Hormuz, prompting the guided-missile destroyer USS McFaul to intervene and provide escort (Source: https://lloydslist.maritimeintelligence.informa.com/). These incidents occurred amidst a broader U.S. military buildup in the Middle East, including the deployment of the Abraham Lincoln Carrier Strike Group and additional destroyers, in response to rising regional tensions. Diplomatic talks between the U.S. and Iran are reportedly scheduled in Oman, but the recent military skirmishes threaten to derail them (Source: https://www.bne.eu/). Tracking whether tactical, non-engagement uses of force (like drone interceptions and warning shots) continue in the coming weeks provides crucial insight into the trajectory of U.S.-Iran relations and the potential for a larger conflict.

Sources:
bne IntelliNews - https://www.bne.eu/
DefenseScoop - https://defensescoop.com/
Lloyd's List - https://lloydslist.maritimeintelligence.informa.com/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) or the U.S. Department of Defense officially announces that U.S. military forces used kinetic force (including but not limited to warning shots, interceptions or shoot-downs of drones/missiles/aircraft, or direct strikes) against assets explicitly identified as belonging to Iran or the Iranian military (e.g., IRGC, Iranian Navy, Iranian Armed Forces), and the incident occurs between 2026-02-06 and 2026-02-25 (inclusive). 

The official announcement must be published by CENTCOM or the DoD, for example via official press releases (https://www.centcom.mil/MEDIA/PRESS-RELEASES/ or https://www.defense.gov/News/Releases/) or their official social media accounts (e.g., https://x.com/CENTCOM). The targeted asset must be explicitly attributed to the state of Iran; actions against Iranian-backed proxies (e.g., Houthi or Hezbollah forces) without direct attribution of the asset to the Iranian state do not qualify.

This question resolves Yes if the qualifying event occurs between 2026-02-06 and 2026-02-25. If no such announcement is made regarding an event occurring within this time window, or if the event is delayed or postponed beyond the resolution window, the question resolves No.
subquestions.rationale: The ultimate question resolves 'Yes' if there is a direct military engagement by June 30, 2026, but it explicitly excludes drone interceptions and warning shots from triggering a 'Yes' resolution. However, tracking whether the U.S. continues to engage in these lower-level tactical skirmishes (like the February 4 drone shootdown) serves as an excellent early indicator. If U.S. forces continue to intercept Iranian drones or fire warning shots between February 6 and February 25, it demonstrates sustained, high-level military friction that significantly increases the probability of a miscalculation or escalation into a full military engagement by June 2026.

question: Will there be exactly 1 earthquake of magnitude 7.0 or higher worldwide by December 31?
description:
This market will resolve according to the total number of earthquakes with a magnitude of 7.0 or higher that occur anywhere on Earth between October 13, 2025, 12:00 PM ET, and December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET.

The resolution source for this market is the United States Geological Survey (USGS) Earthquake Hazards Program (https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/browse/significant.php#sigdef).

If an earthquake of substantial size has occurred within this market's timeframe but not yet appeared on the resolution source, this market may remain open until January 7, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or until the earthquake in question otherwise appears on the resolution source. If such an earthquake has not appeared on the resolution source by that date, another credible resolution source will be used.

subquestions.question: Will the USGS record 10 or more earthquakes of magnitude 6.0 or higher worldwide between 2025-11-13 and 2025-12-09?
subquestions.background_information:
According to historical U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) data, there are typically about 130 to 150 earthquakes of magnitude 6.0 to 6.9 worldwide per year, which averages to roughly 11 to 12 per month. Global seismic activity can occasionally fluctuate above or below this baseline; for example, reports from late October 2025 highlight significant ongoing activity, including a magnitude 6.7 in the Banda Sea and frequent aftershocks in Russia's Kamchatka Peninsula following an 8.8-magnitude quake in July 2025. Because magnitude 7.0+ earthquakes are relatively rare (averaging around 10 to 20 per year), forecasters often rely on the frequency of magnitude 6.0+ earthquakes over a shorter time window as a proxy to model the current global seismic baseline rate.

Sources:
USGS Earthquake Statistics: https://www.usgs.gov/programs/earthquake-hazards/lists-maps-and-statistics
USGS Earthquake Search: https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/search/
Newsweek: https://www.newsweek.com/
VolcanoDiscovery: https://www.volcanodiscovery.com/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if the United States Geological Survey (USGS) Earthquake Hazards Program records 10 or more earthquakes of magnitude 6.0 or higher worldwide between 2025-11-13 00:00:00 UTC and 2025-12-09 23:59:59 UTC, inclusive.

The official resolution source will be the USGS Earthquake Catalog Search (https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/search/). To verify resolution:
1. Access the USGS Earthquake Catalog Search.
2. Set the 'Magnitude' parameter to a minimum of 6.0.
3. Set the 'Date & Time' parameter to start on 2025-11-13 00:00:00 and end on 2025-12-09 23:59:59 (UTC).
4. Set the 'Geographic Region' to 'World'.
5. Count the total number of resulting earthquakes.

If the resulting count is 10 or greater, the question resolves Yes. If the count is 9 or fewer, it resolves No. In the event of an earthquake's magnitude being revised by the USGS prior to resolution (the data will be checked on 2025-12-12 to account for slight delays in final measurements), the revised magnitude will be used. If the USGS catalog is unavailable or ceases to function permanently, the European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre (EMSC) catalog (https://www.emsc-csem.org/Earthquake/) will be used as a fallback source.
subquestions.rationale: The frequency of magnitude 6.0+ earthquakes acts as a reliable proxy for short-term global seismic activity rates. Understanding the current Poisson rate of earthquakes is crucial for forecasting whether 'exactly 1' magnitude 7.0+ earthquake will occur by the end of December. If the baseline rate of 6.0+ earthquakes is unusually high (potentially pushing the number of 7.0+ earthquakes to 2 or more) or unusually low (potentially keeping the number of 7.0+ earthquakes at 0), this subquestion provides valuable, measurable evidence to update probabilities for the ultimate question.

question: US congress stock trading ban in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if any bill with the effect of banning sitting members of the US congress from trading stocks is signed into law by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the US federal government, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

subquestions.question: Will either chamber of the US Congress hold a roll call vote on legislation banning sitting members of Congress from trading individual stocks by October 1, 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
There has been growing pressure to ban members of Congress from trading individual stocks, fueled by recent public scrutiny and high-profile returns from some lawmakers' portfolios. Several bills have been introduced in both chambers, including the End Congressional Stock Trading Act (H.R. 1908) and the PELOSI Act. On August 29-30, 2025, Rep. Anna Paulina Luna (R-FL) announced her intention to file a discharge petition to force a House floor vote on H.R. 1908, a maneuver that requires 218 signatures to bypass House leadership. Meanwhile, the Senate has seen similar pushes, with the Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee advancing a stock trading ban bill. Congress returns from recess in September 2025 with a packed schedule, primarily focused on avoiding a government shutdown by the September 30 deadline. Whether a stock trading ban can secure a floor vote amid these competing priorities will be a strong indicator of its chances to become law in 2025.

Sources:
One America News Network: https://www.oann.com/newsroom/rep-luna-introduces-resolution-to-advance-the-end-congressional-stock-trading-act/
Associated Press: https://apnews.com/article/congress-government-shutdown-stock-trading-7f8e9d
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if the US House of Representatives or the US Senate holds a floor roll call vote on the passage of a bill, or on the adoption of an amendment, that would prohibit sitting members of the US Congress from trading individual stocks. The vote must occur between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01 (inclusive).

The primary sources for resolution will be the official roll call vote records of the US House of Representatives (https://clerk.house.gov/Votes) and the US Senate (https://www.senate.gov/legislative/votes_new.htm). 

Legislation that requires members to place individual stocks in a qualified blind trust or divest them entirely qualifies as a ban for the purposes of this question. Voice votes, unanimous consent agreements, and committee-level votes do not count. Furthermore, procedural votes (such as cloture votes, motions to proceed, motions to table, or votes on a special rule or discharge petition) do not count; the vote must be a direct roll call vote on the passage of the qualifying bill or the adoption of the qualifying amendment. If no such roll call vote occurs within the specified window, the question resolves No.
subquestions.rationale: A floor vote in September 2025 would demonstrate that the push for a stock trading ban has overcome significant committee and leadership hurdles. If a roll call vote occurs, it signals high momentum (likely driven by the discharge petition or bipartisan pressure), increasing the likelihood of the ban becoming law by the end of 2025. If no vote is held by October 1, it indicates that the legislation remains stalled despite the aggressive discharge petition effort, sharply lowering the probability of passage before the end of the year.
